If successful we will request a home check at this stage along with proof of identification and address. We will require written permission from a landlord for all applicants in rented accommodation.

Please note we require all resident dogs to be neutered and up to date with vaccinations before we will proceed with the adoption.

name: Bruno
description:
Meet Bruno – A Gentle Soul Looking for a Fresh Start

Bruno, a 3 year old male American Bulldog, came into our care through no fault of his own after his owner sadly passed away. Following this, poor Bruno experienced a very distressing situation when he was removed from his home.

He was at risk of being euthanised in police kennels, but thankfully we were able to step in just in time and give him the second chance he deserved.

Understandably, Bruno arrived feeling nervous and unsure of the world. But with patience and kindness, he’s been growing in confidence every day.

He’s formed lovely bonds with our staff, enjoys meeting new volunteers, and absolutely loves his gentle walks—plodding along, taking in the scenery, and having a good sniff.

Once he gets to know you, Bruno shows his true nature: a sweet, affectionate boy who loves fuss and closeness. Despite his size, he walks beautifully on the lead—you sometimes forget he’s even there!

As we don’t know much about his background, Bruno will need a quiet, calm, child-free and pet-free home where he can fully decompress, feel safe, and learn to enjoy life again at his own pace.

Bruno is currently staying in our Wrexham kennels, but what he truly needs is a loving home of his own. He’s been through so much, yet he still has so much love to give.

Could you be the one to offer Bruno his forever home?

A link to our adoption process can be found below:

https://celandinewoodanimalrescue.org.uk/adoption-processes/

Once we have received your application this will be reviewed by our dog team and if you are a suitable match one of our volunteers will be in touch within 7 days to discuss your application in more detail.

You will then be invited to meet the dog, and we encourage 2-3 meet & greets for you to get to know your chosen dog, we are happy to introduce you to multiple dogs on the day of they are suitable matches.

We do request all household members attend meet & greets including resident dogs.

If successful we will request a home check at this stage along with proof of identification and address. We will require written permission from a landlord for all applicants in rented accommodation.

Please note we require all resident dogs to be neutered and up to date with vaccinations before we will proceed with the adoption.

name: Sadie
description:
Sadie is a beautiful, fun loving girl pup ready to join her new family both outside on walks and on the sofa of an evening.

She was rescued in Cyprus when she was 5 months old. But no home offers were made so we have recently flown her to a foster home in Milton Keynes in the hope that now she can be met by prospective adopters she may find her perfect family.

Sadie is a stunning, very clever, big puppy with the sweetest nature. She’s incredibly well behaved, gets along perfectly with all dogs, and is already showing wonderful obedience for her age.

This gorgeous girl is also super cuddly, she loves nothing more than being close and showering her people with affection.

Sadie really is the full package: smart, social, gentle, and loving.

She is a mixed breed, possibly with a bit of Anatolian Shepherd, weighing 26 kg at present and expected to be around 32kg when fully grown.

So she will be a large girl. When you look at her photos you will see just what a beautifully stunning model girl she is, long legs to boot!

Sadie was a very happy, playful girl in our kennels, enjoyed playing with the other pups and dogs and being with our volunteers. Now she is in the UK this is translating well into her foster home and she is learning about home life quickly.

Already learned the basic about house training, sleeping soundly at night, she is now learning to walk on the lead and enjoy her time out and about, meeting other dogs nicely and enjoying a weekend treat of a puppuccino from the local coffee shop!

She is living happily with teenagers and in view of her size we would prefer any children in her new home to be dog savvy and older.

Sadie is a typical pup who will benefit from her adopters spending quality time with her to help her settle in her new family life and continue on her journey to learn what is expected of a family dog.

Her foster family say she is a beautiful, well balance puppy with lots of fun and zest!

If you are looking for a good sized pup with potential, please when contacting us tell us a little about yourself:

3. Your garden and fencing (height at lowest point)

5. Ages of children in the home or who visit

6. How long Sadie may be left alone, and how she’ll fit into your lifestyle

Sadie is vaccinated, and microchipped. A minimum adoption donation of £300 applies.

Adoption is subject to a satisfactory application, home check, neutering agreement at his adopters expense when she reaches the appropriate age as agreed with your vet and agreement to our adoption conditions.

We are committed to the lifelong care of our dogs and will always accept their return when space allows. In situations where space is limited, we will endeavour to rehome the dog directly from its current home.

Under no circumstances may the dog be transferred to another UK rescue organisation.

name: Marvel
description:
Marvel is a 6-year-old male Cross-Breed. He’s a medium-sized lad with a sensitive streak, especially when it comes to meeting new people at home. Despite this, his first family said he settled quickly and was happy to greet visitors once he felt safe.

Marvel accepts a collar and has previously used a harness without issue. His lead manners are mostly decent, with only the occasional pull, and even then it’s nothing dramatic.

He does, however, become fear-reactive around lively dogs on walks, so he needs space and understanding from other dog walkers.

Marvel is fully toilet trained, though he’s not crate trained, and he’s never shown any destructive behaviour. He can be left alone for a few hours without trouble, although he will bark at outside noises.

He sleeps soundly overnight with his owner and travels well in the car.

Marvel is great with food and loves his treats, showing no signs of resource guarding at all. His former families describe him as a loving, snuggly boy once trust is built. They also say he’s clever, affectionate, and happiest chilling beside his humans.

Marvel thrives best in a calm environment without small children or other dogs. With patience and reassurance, he’ll grow into a loyal and devoted companion. His gentle nature shines through once he feels safe and understood.

name: Raegan
description:
Meet Raegan. Raegan is a 9 month old female Cross-Breed and is small to medium in size.

Raegan is a lovely girl to someone she builds a bond with but is nervous of strangers. She will do better in a home with fewer people and not many visitors.

But someone able to dedicate time to her and help with training for her guarding would be considered too.

Raegan is toilet and crate trained. She wears a harness whilst out and walks well. She is doing well with other unknown things around her when she’s with confident dogs.

She showed anxiety when left alone previously but in her foster home she can be left with other dogs for up to 4 hours; if she was living without dogs, any alone time would need to be built up gradually.

She sleeps well overnight in the foster’s room but in a dog bed or with other dogs dotted around the home. She travels well in the boot of the car with no travel sickness. She has not been destructive.

Raegan’s foster says, ‘Raegan is a dear little dog, she’s feisty and full of personality. She loves living with other dogs but is not so confident with humans (besides me). She plays all day and is a typical cute puppy’.

name: Peaches
description:
Our extra special girl Peaches is approximately three years old and a beautiful cross breed with something of a hound appearance.

Peaches weighs a perfect fourteen kilos and measures eleven inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Peaches has been in our Cyprus shelter for two months.

Our shelter manager describes Peaches as incredibly loving who is an absolute sweetheart. Without a doubt Peaches has lived in a home before being abandoned and remains in perfect condition.

Peaches has so many positive attributes with a calm and gentle demeanour and oozes kindness and gentility. She is longing for her forever home and has so much to offer.

With a glorious white and tan coat and woeful eyes she is visibly stunning. Her shapely ears complete with freckles and remarkable. Peaches is such a low maintenance girl who is a prize for her lucky adopters.

Peaches walks nicely on her lead and thoroughly enjoys her time in the car and. She seems to mix perfectly with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Barney
description:
Barney is an 5 year old male Cross-Breed.

He has spent his entire life in a foster shelter, where he has been well cared for and socialised.

As a friendly and affectionate dog, Barney has lovely markings that make him stand out, including a distinctive patch over his eye that adds to his charm.

Despite his time in the shelter, Barney remains a cheerful and loving companion who is eager to find his forever home.

He has been cat-tested and has shown he can live harmoniously with cats, which is a positive trait for potential adopters with feline friends.

He is friendly with other dogs, friendly but nervous of humans.

Barney is expected to be a smallish adult, making him a suitable choice for those who prefer a smaller dog.

He is microchipped, vaccinated, and has undergone various tests to ensure his health and well-being.

Additionally, Barney comes with a pet passport, which can be advantageous for future travel or if moving abroad.

Being one of several siblings also awaiting adoption, Barney’s sweet and friendly nature makes him a wonderful candidate for any family looking to add a loving dog to their home.

name: Jess
description:
Jess is a 7-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is a medium-sized boy who lacks confidence when out on the lead and currently will not go very far. This is something that will need continued work and patience in his new home.

Jess is a 7-year-old male Cross-Breed who will need a secure garden with direct access. Having a safe outdoor space will help him feel more comfortable and reduce pressure while his confidence builds. A quieter home environment would suit him best.

Jess is a 7-year-old male Cross-Breed who has shared a kennel with various dogs during his time at OSH. He prefers calmer and quieter dogs and would be best matched with a similar canine companion. Busy or overly energetic dogs may overwhelm him.

Jess is a 7-year-old male Cross-Breed who has recently begun waiting at the front of his kennel to go out. He gets very excited around food and has started barking more as a result. These behaviours appear linked to his increasing engagement with his surroundings.

Jess is a 7-year-old male Cross-Breed who is slowly making improvements overall. The kennel environment is noisy, which can be challenging for him and affect his confidence levels. A calmer household would likely help him continue progressing.

Jess is a 7-year-old male Cross-Breed who cannot live with cats and would be best suited to a home with children aged 15 and over.

Older children are more likely to understand his need for space and reassurance. With time and consistency, he has the potential to settle well in the right home.

name: Barry
description:
Barry is a 9-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is a medium-sized boy who is described as friendly and happy once he knows and trusts you. When he feels comfortable, his warm and affectionate personality really comes through.

Barry is a 9-year-old male Cross-Breed who was rescued off the streets by UK volunteers during a recent trip. This background means he will need understanding and patience as he settles into a home environment.

Despite his past, he shows a strong desire for human connection.

Barry is a 9-year-old male Cross-Breed who absolutely loves attention and enjoys being fussed over. He thrives on affection and would enjoy a home where he can receive plenty of one-to-one interaction.

His loving nature makes him very endearing once a bond is formed.

Barry is a 9-year-old male Cross-Breed who can feel a little nervous around new people. He may take some time to relax, but with calm handling and reassurance he is able to build trust. A patient and consistent approach will help him feel secure.

Barry is a 9-year-old male Cross-Breed who cannot live with other dogs. He is best suited to being the only dog in the household, where he does not have to share attention or space. This setup will allow him to feel more settled and confident.

Barry is a 9-year-old male Cross-Breed who cannot live with cats or children. He would be best suited to an adult-only home where his needs and boundaries are clearly understood.

In the right environment, he would make a loyal and affectionate companion.

name: Freya
description:
Freya is a 3 year old large female Cross-Breed.

Freya doesn’t like people walking past her kennel. She is quite nervous of people but once she gains trust she is very happy and loves cuddles.

She is very treat oriented which is good but she does try and snatch the treats. She’s great with lead and collar and walks well no problem at all. She’s fine on walks and walking past people but she starts barking at dogs and is unsure.’

Freya can be nervous of people coming into the home which will cause her to bark and growl, she is best meeting people out on a walk first so she can become comfortable with them.

She is then generally okay within the home however she can sometimes bark if visitors make sudden movements which startle her so will need to use her safe space longer term. She is not crate trained so would prefer a dog bed.

Freya is toilet trained and travels well in the car. It is felt Freya could do very short periods on her own but this would need to be built up very slowly in her new home. Therefore, she will need someone that is home all day.

Freya needs a female primary carer, ideally in a female only home or with a confident, very dedicated male who can slowly build a relationship with her.

Using a safe space long term so that she feels safe, builds confidence and has somewhere she can go if she feels overwhelmed before trigger stacking is absolutely vital for Freya.

Her new home will need to be committed and dedicated to allowing her to go at her own pace in order to settle and become comfortable in her new home.

Once she has built up a bond based on trust she will show how loving and affectionate she really is.

name: Alba
description:
Alba is a 11 year old female Terrier Cross. She is a playful and affectionate dog who adores spending time with people and children, making her a delightful companion in a family setting.

Alba is house trained, which shows she is well-behaved indoors, and she also walks well on a lead, demonstrating good leash manners that make outings enjoyable for both her and her owner.

Alba has a history of being reactive towards other dogs, but she has made significant progress and can now go on walks alongside other dogs without issues.

She shows a preference for male dogs, which is important for potential adopters to consider when introducing her to new canine friends.

Alba is best suited for families with children over 8 years old and she cannot live with cats, ensuring a safe and harmonious home environment.

Alba is microchipped and fully vaccinated, including rabies, infectious diseases twice, and will receive the Bordetella vaccine before transport.

She has been castrated and tested negative for Mediterranean diseases and Brucellosis, and she received nasal treatment for kennel cough before travel.

Her health and safety are carefully monitored, reflecting the high standard of care provided by Ninas Haven.

Adopters should note that an adoption fee of £150 applies, along with a home check, and full rescue backup is provided by Ninas Haven.

Alba’s well-rounded personality, progress with dog interactions, and affectionate nature make her a fantastic companion for the right home.

name: Skye
description:
Skye is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed and is large in size. She can live with confident cats, can live with other dogs following successful meets, and would be best suited to a home with children aged 16 years and over. She is based in Cheshire.

Skye is reactive to new people visiting the home, so she will need a household with minimal visitors. Her new family will need to continue working with her on this.

With the people she knows and trusts, Skye is a happy, loving, and affectionate girl. She is a big puppy at heart with a goofy personality. She loves playing with her toys and enjoys enrichment such as kongs and lick mats.

Skye accepts a collar, harness, and lead. She is very strong on the lead and does pull. She can be highly reactive on walks, particularly towards other dogs and people.

However, she has made friends with a small dog near her home and is good with them.

Skye is toilet trained and crate trained. She does display destructive behaviour towards items such as furniture and remote controls. The cause of this is unknown, but it is improving over time.

She can be left alone but needs to be crated to prevent destruction. She settles well overnight and travels well on short car journeys.

Skye can also be reactive to people walking past the home, so a quiet location or a property with a private entrance would be ideal. She may show guarding behaviour around high value treats such as bones with other dogs, so these should be avoided.

name: Casper
description:
Casper is a 5-year-old male Cross-Breed. He sadly lost his home after his owner passed away, and the family who remained couldn’t take him when they moved.

He had previously lived with Stella and was adopted not long after her, so all this upheaval has been a lot for him to handle.

Casper is a 5-year-old no gender Cross-Breed. Even with everything going on, he stays incredibly friendly and absolutely adores people and other dogs.

He’s house trained too, which makes things so much easier for anyone welcoming him into their home.

Casper is a 5-year-old no gender Cross-Breed. He’s currently in Bosnia and will be able to travel mid-January, ready for a fresh start with someone who can give him stability again.

He has already been vaccinated, blood tested, microchipped, neutered, and treated for fleas and worms.

Casper is a 5-year-old no gender Cross-Breed. Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue in the UK is providing rescue support for him, ensuring he’s backed by a team that genuinely wants the best for him.

Anyone interested in adopting him will need to complete an application and home check, but he’s truly worth it.

name: Francis Rossi
description:
Our very own Francis Rossi is looking for an adoring, fun-filled home to match his great big heart! He is 3 years old, 70cm from floor to shoulder, and weighs about 45kg.

Francis is the epitome of a loving companion. He will make you laugh while simultaneously melting your heart. He was fearful to begin with, but now greets people with a bright eye and a very bushy tail.

Francis walks well on a lead, doesn’t pull, and is not bothered when meeting or walking with other dogs. He’s good around horses and sheep too. He hasn’t been cat-tested but has a low prey drive.

Francis loves a zoomy so he’d like a home with a big garden where he can really go for it and impress you!

Francis is a healthy boy – vaccinated, castrated, and blood tested. He is currently in foster in West Sussex but can be adopted anywhere in the UK. He will have full rescue backup from Mastin Matters.

If you’d like to see some videos of this gorgeous boy, please get in touch!

name: Balto
description:
Little Balto was abandoned and was living the life of strays in a village with his two siblings when he was rescued.

Sadly their beautiful mum is still out there, too frightened of people to be caught.

At just 4 months old, Balto is a sweet-natured little boy with a beautiful, smiling face and a heart to match. He’s soft, cuddly and friendly with everyone he meets.

He is playful and kind, loves other dogs and would be delighted to have a canine friend in his new home. He could also live with older, dog savvy children.

Balto is expected to be medium size when fully grown and is ready to travel to his new home once the right family is found for him.

He has his whole life ahead of him and he’s ready to start a new chapter — one filled with love, safety and cuddles.

name: Nashi
description:
Nashi is a 2-year-old medium-sized girl (20 kg) who is waiting for her chance at a public shelter in Hungary.

She is the sweetest natured, friendly girl who is very affectionate and loves all people she meets! She walks beautifully on the lead and she’s already doing brilliantly at overcoming new challenges.

A lovable dog like Nashi deserves so much more than life behind bars.

She is waiting for her special person who wants to share their life with her and is happy to give her all the love and care she has missed her first two years of life.

Nashi is compatible with other dogs and can also live with older dog savvy children.

name: Kormi
description:
Meet Kormi, a 7-year-old, 17 kg terrier-type boy with a scruffy black-and-white coat, a cute white chest, and the funniest little pointy ears! But it’s his big personality that really makes him stand out!

Kormi ended up at a public shelter due to poor living conditions, so it’s fair to say life hasn’t always been kind to him, and now he’s waiting behind bars for someone to give him the happy ending he deserves.

But this cheeky little chap is full of life, energy and character! He loves pottering about, keeping busy and, when he’s really excited, can even spin around on his back! He’s guaranteed to make you smile!

Kormi is always delighted to get out of his kennel for a walk and behaved beautifully on the lead, paying little attention to passing dogs. He’s also friendly, affectionate and cuddly, and absolutely loves being close to people.

Kormi is a wonderful little boy with plenty of personality! He is looking for someone who will appreciate his cheeky, spirited nature and welcome a little fun and mischief into their everyday life.

Kormi is neutered, fully vaccinated, and ready to travel once the right home is found for him.

name: Sully
description:
Sully is a 5 year old medium size male cross breed. He looks like someone accidentally shrunk a Rottweiler in the wash. He’s handsome, compact, and has mastered the art of looking at you as if he’s contemplating the meaning of life.

Sully’s story didn’t begin so happily, he was surrendered in Hungary by a British family along with several other dogs.

They arrived frightened of people, fearful of new experiences, and clearly hadn’t been shown the love, kindness and guidance that every dog deserves.

For Sully the world was a scary place initially. But then he saw people who were kind to him, spoke gently, and gave him time. And it didn’t take long for him to realise that not all humans let you down.

Today Sully is a completely different dog, he enjoys life and likes human company, and although he still has his moments of insecurity, he is now curious and not fearful of the world around him.

He is a loyal, kind natured boy, quite placid in temperament. He isn’t a high energy dog either who would need endless adventures and entertainment all through the day, but he will happily join you on your walks and then enjoy home time sharing the sofa with you.

What he really wants though is a family who won’t give up on him.

Sully is friendly with most dogs with sensible introductions, very excitable dogs are probably not the best match for him but he could happily live with a friendly placid dog.

He is friendly around children, too, but he would probably be best suited to an adult-only home as he is not used to the noise and chaos that can come with young children.

We can cat test him for the right applicant.

He would really love to leave his shelter days behind and start a new life.

And he comes with a special bonus in that he understands English!

Sully is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes neutered, microchipped, fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

attributes.Breed: Staffordshire bull terrier cross labrador retriever

name: Zelda
description:
Meet Zelda, a 2 year old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier cross Labrador Retriever — a brave and beautiful girl who has survived unimaginable cruelty yet still greets the world with love.

She came from hell. Zelda spent her early life chained so short she couldn’t even stand, the chain cutting deep into her neck. Despite such cruelty, she never lost her spark. Once freed, she greeted her rescuers with a wagging tail and a forgiving heart.

Now safe, she’s blossomed into an energetic, happy-natured girl. She’s medium-sized, affectionate, and adores people.

Zelda gets along well with other dogs — though she can be a bit boisterous in her play — and would thrive either as an only dog or with a friendly, tolerant companion.

In the kennel, she doesn’t get the exercise or freedom she craves, and she’s longing for a home where she can run, play, and finally just be a dog. She loves her walks, though she does pull on the lead, simply excited to be out exploring the world she missed for so long.

Zelda would suit an active home that can give her the exercise, structure, and affection she craves, so her joyful spirit can shine at long last. Older children will be considered.

Zelda has endured pain no animal should ever know. She deserves a life full of love, freedom, and fun.

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Agika
description:
Agika is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed. She is a small cross-breed girl looking for her forever family.

This little girl has suffered so much in her short life; still, she is a little miracle. She was rescued from a heartbreaking situation where she had been kept on a short chain that had grown deep into her neck.

Once she was released, the chain had to be surgically removed.

Despite a truly rough start, Agika is a real sweetheart—loving, affectionate, and full of life. When she was rescued, she was timid and afraid of the world.

However, she soon left her old self behind, learned that some people can be trusted, and has grown into a joyful dog who loves life, loves other dogs, and now loves people too.

She walks nicely on the lead and looks forward to her walks, which she does not get many of.

She loves attention and will happily accept any amount of cuddles or affection. Agika is ready to start a new life in a safe, loving home where she will be treated the way she has always deserved.

She wants to be part of the family and discover all the things she has not yet had the chance to see or sniff.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred but is not essential, as all applications are assessed individually.

Agika is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her. She comes spayed and fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full rescue backup is provided.

name: Malna
description:
Malna is a 3 year old crossbreed girl, she was dumped on the roadside along with her sister at about 2.5 months of age. She is medium size, weight: 15 kg, shoulder height: 44 cm.

Malna is a lovely girl, she is friendly and kind and loves everyone. She is energetic and playful and sociable around her doggie mates.

She enjoys nothing more than running around in the fields with other dogs, playing a chase. She cooperates nicely with humans too and is very kind with humans.

She enjoys car rides and is good around children too. She also walks nicely on the lead.

Malna would be best suited for a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and she is included in her family’s activities. She would be happiest in an active family, she would happily be your company on long walks, hikes and holidays.

Older dog savvy children will be considered.

Malna would probably be happiest living with another playful dog but she could also live happily as the only dog and the centre of attention in her home.

As all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Malna is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to Home Check and Adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Tango
description:
Tango is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed. He was saved from the streets with his 4 siblings and their mum, who is a Dachshund cross.

Tango is a very kind-natured boy—friendly, affectionate, and playful. He has a beautiful, friendly look and a well-proportioned build. He loves people and enjoys a lively, playful lifestyle.

He is very social with his doggie mates and plays well with them.

Tango would be best suited for a family where he is not left alone for extended periods and is treated as a family member. He would love to go on nice adventures! He will need time to settle into his new home, and his training will need to be continued.

He could live happily with another friendly, playful dog or as the only dog in the home, being the centre of attention.

As with all rescue dogs, he will need time, patience, love, and commitment from his adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog. Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Tango is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Junior
description:
Junior is a 3-year-old male Dachshund Cross. He was rescued from a deprived area of Hungary in very poor condition and has since been given a second chance at life. Despite everything he has been through, he has remained a sweet and affectionate little dog.

He has been waiting patiently while other dogs around him have found homes, yet he has somehow been overlooked. This is especially sad because he is described as a lovable and funny boy who truly enjoys human company.

More than anything, he is simply longing to be part of a family of his own.

Junior walks nicely on the lead and enjoys getting out and about. He loves people and shows a gentle and friendly nature in his interactions. His kind temperament also means he is patient when around children.

When it comes to other dogs, Junior’s preference is for female dogs. He would be happiest living with a spayed female companion or as the only dog in the home where he can soak up all the attention.

This flexibility means he could suit different home setups, as long as his social preferences are respected.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, which gives his future family reassurance about his health care. He also has an EU pet passport, making his travel arrangements clear and straightforward.

A home check and adoption fee will apply, and full rescue back-up is provided for added support.

Junior is a small dog at approximately 10 kg, making him a manageable size for many households. His journey has not been easy, but his gentle nature and cheerful personality have stayed intact.

He is ready to leave his difficult past behind and finally enjoy the comfort and security of a loving home.

name: Suzy
description:
Suzy is a 1.5 year old female Cross-Breed, medium in size. She was rescued exactly a year ago from horrid circumstances, having been thrown into a yard with her brother, Tommy, at just a few weeks of age.

They lived on piles of rubbish, frequently escaping due to inadequate fencing and roaming the streets among busy traffic, constantly in danger. When rescued, they were emaciated and full of parasites.

Suzy has grown to be a kind-natured, healthy girl who is active and playful according to her age. She is medium-sized and has a lovely cheeky character. She loves people and is very friendly around kids, too.

She is also playful and happy around other dogs.

Suzy is perhaps slightly more reserved than her brother and enjoys doggie company a lot. She loves to play and run with her mates.

Suzy would be happiest in a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and there is time for her training. We want her to be treated as a treasured member of the family and be taken on nice adventures. She will need time to settle into her new home and get used to her environment.

Suzy could happily live with another friendly and playful dog or dogs but may also be happy being the only dog and the centre of attention in the family.

As with all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love, and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Suzy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Maggie
description:
Maggie is a beautiful, smaller-medium-sized 2 year old Cross-Breed girl who may be a little shy when meeting new people, but give her some time and patience, and she’ll have the chance to show you what a lovely companion she can be.

She gets on brilliantly with other dogs and could happily share her home with canine friends. She could also live with older children who understand that some dogs need a little time to feel comfortable.

We can also cat test her if needed for the right applicant.

Maggie’s story began in difficult circumstances. She and her six siblings were born in an abandoned property, where their emaciated mum struggled to feed her puppies.

The little family was taken in by the local shelter when the pups were just three weeks old.

All seven puppies were stunningly beautiful, but heartbreakingly, two are still waiting for their forever families. Maggie is now two years old, and it’s time her own happy ending began.

Maggie’s spayed, fully vaccinated and ready to travel once the right family is found.

Home check and adoption fee apply. Full RBU provided.

name: Beigli
description:
Beigli is a 1.5 year-old medium-sized crossbreed boy with a beautiful soul. Born in an abandoned property alongside his six siblings, little Beigli’s life began in heartbreaking circumstances.

His mum was desperately trying to keep her babies alive while she herself was painfully thin and starving.

At just three weeks old, the family was rescued and brought to safety.

The puppies grew up, one by one they found their forever homes, and today only two remain: Beigli and his sister Maggie.

At just 1.5 years old, Beigli has already spent almost his entire life waiting.

He adores people, loves playing with other dogs, and has the kind, gentle nature that makes everyone fall in love with him.

All Beigli dreams of is a family to call his own. A warm bed. Daily walks. Someone to greet with a wagging tail and endless devotion.

He can live with older dog-savvy children and can be cat tested for the right applicant.

Beigli is in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as the right family finds him.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, with an EU pet passport.

name: Jenny
description:
Jenny is a 10 year old female Airedale Terrier Cross with a heartbreaking past and a heart full of hope. For seven long years, she was left chained outside without shelter or kindness, while the world looked away.

Her suffering only came to light by chance — her rescuers were returning another dog when they saw her standing there, neglected and desperate.

Jenny’s eyes lit up as if she knew this was her moment, and when her owner was asked to surrender her, he did so without hesitation.

Since that day, Jenny has been safe, but her home has been a kennel. A whole year has passed, and she is still waiting for the love she has never truly known.

Jenny is gentle and people-oriented. She loves her walks and is good on the lead, though she can be a little strong at times. She enjoys chasing a ball and, while she isn’t interested in making doggy friends, she’s content as long as her space is respected.

Jenny would be happiest as the only dog in the home so she doesn’t have to share attention or space.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, and travels with her EU pet passport — ready to start the new chapter she so deserves.

Jenny has lost so many years, but it’s not too late for her to find happiness! All she wants now is to spend her golden years knowing comfort, kindness, and love.

Could you give her the forever home she has waited a lifetime for?

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Loki
description:
Loki, a beautiful 2 year old Siberian Husky needs a new home through no fault of his own.

The owner has serious health problems and is unable to give him the care and attention he needs and deserves. He is spending more and more time in kennels which is far from ideal.

Loki is a lovely boy, he loves his toys and he has a kind nature. He is currently the only dog in the household, but he is friendly with dogs and wants to play on walks so he has the potential to live with another friendly dog.

He is also used to living with older children.

He is fully vaccinated and microchipped and up to date with flea and wormingtreatments.

Loki is in Chorley, Lancashire where he is visitable upon arrangement.

name: Apollo
description:
Meet Apollo – a gentle soul ready for a new life.

Apollo, a 3.5-year-old medium size cross-breed boy, whose life until now has been far from kind, has finally been freed from a life lived on a chain. Yet somehow, despite everything, he has held onto his sweetness, his trust, and his huge heart.

Apollo is incredibly human-centred, affectionate, and loving — the kind of dog who just wants to be close to people and soak up kindness.

He is wonderfully sociable with other dogs, big and small, and plays beautifully and politely with them. He’s also an absolute dream at the vets, calm and cooperative — everyone who meets him falls for his sweet nature.

He even has the potential to live with cats; in his previous life, he used to sleep in his dog house with a cat companion, sharing warmth and comfort.

He travels nicely in the car, walks well on the lead, and is more than ready to start discovering what family life means.

Currently, Apollo lives in boarding kennels, hoping that one day someone will finally choose him.

Apollo has so much love to give — he just needs someone who will finally give him the life he has always deserved. ?

Apollo comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

He is ready to travel from Hungary as soon as his family is found.

name: Cleo
description:
Cleo is an adorable 11-month-old small mixed breed girl looking for a loving forever home. She and her three siblings were found abandoned as tiny puppies, all in very poor condition, frightened and unsure of the world around them.

With their parents unknown and their future uncertain, all they had was each other.

Thankfully, Cleo has blossomed into a wonderful young dog. Although naturally a little shy when meeting new people or experiencing new situations, she is incredibly sweet, gentle, and affectionate once she feels safe.

Her confidence continues to grow every day.

She loves playing with other dogs and enjoys spending time with people she knows and trusts. Cleo would thrive in a calm, patient home where she can continue building her confidence at her own pace.

In return, she will reward her family with unwavering loyalty and love.

Cleo could happily live with another friendly well-balanced dog and she has all the potential to live with cats, too.

As a small-sized girl, Cleo would make a lovely companion for someone looking for a gentle, kind-hearted dog.

She comes spayed, microchipped, fully vaccinated and with an EU pet passport.

name: Gesztenye
description:
Gesztenye is a beautiful 2-year-old medium-sized brindle girl with the sweetest soul. She adores people, loves playing with other dogs and greets everyone she meets with a wagging tail and a hopeful smile.

For over two years, Gesztenye and her sister Zserbo have shared everything. They were rescued together from a kill shelter when they were only a few weeks old. They grew up side by side, slept in the same kennel, and waited together for someone to finally choose them.

Now Zserbo’s dream has come true. She has found a wonderful family in the UK.

But little Gesztenye will soon watch her sister leave… and for the first time in her life, she will be alone.

She has so much love to give and asks for so little in return – just a family to call her own.

Gesztenye is friendly with dogs and would happily live with another canine companion. She is affectionate, playful and kind natured, and can also live with older dog-savvy children.

She’s looking for a home where she will be part of family life and not left alone for long periods.

Like all rescue dogs, Gesztenye will need time, patience and love, but in return she will give you her whole heart.

Gesztenye is currently in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as her forever family finds her.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, comes with and EU pet passport.

name: Connie
description:
Connie is a 2 year old female Puli Cross. Her story began in a public pound, where she grew up in harsh conditions. A year ago, she was rescued in a heartbreaking state – skin and bone, frightened and frail.

With care, love, and patience, Connie has blossomed into a happy, affectionate girl. Today she’s full of life – her waggy tail never stops, she adores treats and cuddles, and she has even learned to smile when she’s with the people she loves. This beautiful girl has learned to trust again!

Connie loves the company of other dogs and is especially playful – wrestling and mingling are her favourite games! She would be just as happy snuggling up on the sofa as she is joining in on adventures.

Connie is still waiting in a small shelter in Hungary, dreaming of her forever family. She deserves a home where she will be cherished, spoiled, and loved for the sweet, resilient girl she is.

For Connie, an experienced rescue dog home would be ideal – someone patient and understanding, ready to continue guiding her on her journey.

She could live happily with another friendly and playful dog or as the only dog in the home.

2 years oldPlayful, affectionate, sociableSpayed, vaccinated, microchipped, with EU passportCan travel to the UK once her family is found

If you can give Connie the love-filled home she has been waiting for, please get in touch.

Adoption subject to home check & fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Floki
description:
I’m a 5 year old medium size cross breed boy.

For 3.5 years, I’ve been living in a shelter in Hungary, that’s more than half my life spent waiting behind a fence, hoping someone might stop… might notice me… might choose me. But no one ever has. Sometimes I feel invisible. I’m only 5 years old.

I’m not loud or demanding. I’m patient and quiet. I’m the kind of dog who waits in silence and hopes that one day someone will see the good boy I truly am and will not walk past me.

I love my walks, and I walk beautifully on the lead. I enjoy sniffing the world and feeling the sun on my back. I love hoomans—every scratch behind the ears and every cuddle means the world to me, because I get so little affection here.

But I treasure every moment. I never take kindness for granted.

I’m calm and peaceful around other dogs. I don’t want trouble; I just want love.

And although my muzzle is beginning to grey, please don’t think I’m old. I’m still young, playful in my soft and gentle way, and I dream—every single day—of having a home, a bed of my own, and a family who finally calls me theirs.

I have spent so long waiting, but I haven’t given up.I still believe my person is out there.

If you’re reading this… maybe it’s you.Maybe you’re the one who will make sure I’m invisible no more.

Floki is ready to travel from Hungary once the right family is found.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, with an EU passport.

name: Missy
description:
Missy is a tiny 2-year-old Chihuahua cross who deserves so much better than the hand life has dealt her.

She was dumped by her own owner in a neighbouring village, along with another dog. Perhaps they thought that if they left them somewhere unfamiliar, the dogs wouldn’t find their way home.

Sadly, Missy was left to fend for herself by the very person who should have cared for her.

But despite her past, this little girl has plenty of love to give.

Missy is a cuddly, gentle and kind little girl. She loves a cosy, soft bed and never says no to a tasty meal! Missy is protective of her food and may growl at the other dogs coming close to her bowl.

For this same reason, we’re looking for an adult-only home where she can eat her food in peace.

She gets along well with other dogs but is quite happy doing her own thing, so she wouldn’t mind being the only dog in the home.

She is peaceful around cats and could live with a feline companion.

Missy isn’t asking for much – just a warm bed, a full tummy, gentle affection and someone who will never abandon her again. She deserves a home where she’ll always be safe, cherished and wanted.

Missy comes spayed, fully vaccinated, health checked, and with an EU passport.

She is in Hungary, ready to travel once the right home is found for her.

name: Lottie
description:
Lottie is a 2 year old female cross breed who is currently waiting for her forever home in Hungary. This lovely girl has a beautiful smile that could brighten anyone’s day and a happy, cheerful personality to match. Sadly, Lottie has not had the best start in life, having been abandoned by her own owner in a neighbouring village alongside another dog. Thankfully, she remains a wonderfully happy and friendly girl who is ready to find a family of her own.

Lottie is a real little ray of sunshine who loves everyone she meets. She has a lovely outgoing personality and is always ready for some fun and attention. She enjoys playing with other dogs and is happy to make new canine friends, so she could happily join a household where there are already dogs. She is also friendly with cats, making her suitable for a home with existing cats too. Her sociable nature and love of company make her a lovely candidate for a family looking to welcome a friendly and cheerful new companion.

With her happy go lucky attitude and enthusiasm for life, Lottie would make a wonderful addition to a family who can offer her the love, care and security she deserves. She has so much happiness to share and would love to be part of everyday family life, enjoying companionship, playtime and all the little pleasures that come with having a home of her own. After being abandoned by the person who should have cared for her, Lottie is now hoping to find someone who will make her a permanent member of the family and never let her down again.

Lottie is currently in Hungary and will be able to travel once her forever home has been found. A home check and adoption fee will apply, and full rescue back up will be provided to support her new family.

Lottie has so much love and happiness to offer. All she needs now is someone to give her the chance to enjoy the wonderful life she deserves.

name: Val
description:
Val is a small to medium sized crossbreed aged 6 years old.

Val came into our care when she was a puppy, she was soon adopted but has been returned recently because the domestic circumstances had changed.

Val has settled really well back in her foster home. She has been enjoying the company of the other dogs, in particular Tempy who she often initiates play with, we think she would be happiest with another dog for company.

On the first day she was happy to jump up on the sofa next to her foster dad, although initially she wasn’t keen on getting fussed, but already that is changing and especially if food is involved she is happy to have a fuss.

She walks beautifully on a lead and is a pleasure to take out. She is worried by visitors to the home so would like a calm and quiet household.

Val has previously lived happily with cats and could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

name: Ronnie
description:
Ronnie is an 8 month old small male Cross-Breed.

Vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, neutered.

Ronnie is looking for a family after he was abandoned with his brother in Romania. He currently resides in a private foster house.

His brother just found a wonderful home but sadly no one for Ronnie.

Ronnie is a happy little chap who loves belly tickles and human interaction.

He walks on a lead and is described as very well educated and super social.

He doesn’t have any known allergies or intolerances and doesn’t take any medication. He hasn’t show any food guarding behaviour towards other dogs in the foster house.

Rbu- Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK Application and checks apply.

name: Zvonko
description:
Zvonko is a 1-year-old male Cross-Breed currently residing in Croatia. This young and energetic dog found his way to the shelter in early December after being brought in by a utility policeman from Vitaljina.

At the time, Zvonko wasn’t microchipped, and his background remained uncertain. However, through social media posts, his owner was identified.

Despite an initial agreement to retrieve Zvonko on New Year’s Eve, his owner failed to honour the arrangement. Attempts to contact him revealed a sudden change of heart, leaving Zvonko abandoned and in need of a new home.

During his stay at the shelter, Zvonko has been vaccinated, neutered, and microchipped, ensuring he is ready for a fresh start in a loving environment.

Zvonko has a friendly nature and gets along exceptionally well with both dogs and people, making him an excellent candidate for a family looking for a social and loving companion. His personality shines with warmth and affection, and he is eager to bring joy to his future family.

If you’re seeking a loyal and sociable dog to welcome into your home, Zvonko might be the perfect match. By adopting him, you’ll provide the love and security he deserves while gaining a companion who will reward you with endless happiness.

If interested, contact Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue to start the application process and give Zvonko the happy ending he longs for.

name: Wolfy
description:
Shepherd lovers?? Introducing a very special boy called Wolfy.

Good afternoon everybody my name is Wolfy and I’m a 4.5 month male Shepherd, located in Romania.

I will be a large sized male at maturity weighing approximately 30kg. I am looking for a shepherd-experienced home with a secure garden for play time.

At the moment I am living with an older lady who rescued me, but sadly she can’t take care of my needs and this means I am not getting the exercise or mental stimulation that I require.

I currently live with many cats and other dogs. I like my food a lot and won’t say no to a treat or two ? I am described as a happy boy who always has a waggy tail when visitors come.

I walk on a lead and I do require a fit and able person to keep up with my pace. I have a lot still to learn and I’m looking for a home who have lots of time, patience and energy to help me grow and learn.

I can live with older children 14+ who are dog savvy and used to living with a dog in the home.

I am fully vet checked, vaccinated, blood tested, microchipped, flead, wormed, not neutered as yet due to age.

name: Fizz
description:
Fizz is a smallish crossbreed aged around 3 year old.

We met Fizz on our recent trip to the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She was in pen 104 with three other dogs that were very friendly and good at drawing our attention. It’s really thanks to them that we noticed her as she is not one to push herself forward in a crowd of 800 dogs.

Fizz is a cute but shy little girl who wants to behave like the adolescent she is but until now life had knocked the play out of her. She has been in the UK for a few weeks now and yesterday surprised both us and herself when she picked up a ball. She had no idea what to do with it so just paraded it proudly around her foster siblings.

She is learning to relax and enjoy life but still has a way to go to be completely carefree as she should be. She will need at least one other dog as full time resident in her forever home. She has learnt how to walk on a lead but will need to continue to gain experience in her forever home.

It’s so hard for them when everything around them is new and every experience is a “first”, but this little jewel is so ready to break through her fears niw and just needs somewhere to continue to do so. She can live with children aged ten plus and seems unphased by the cat.

name: Olivia
description:
Olivia is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed. She currently resides in private foster in Romania. She was abandoned on the street in Romania.

It is apparent that she had spent some time on a chain as she has a chain mark on her neck. Olivia hasn’t shown any behaviours whilst being in private foster.

Olivia is a kind and calm soul who is people friendly despite her previous trauma. She doesn’t show any aggression towards the other dogs, she has no bite history whilst being in private foster.

Olivia is a tiny little girl who doesn’t require lots of exercise. Two small walks a day with play time in between would be adequate for Olivia.

Olivia is a little shy at first in meeting with new people but Olivia is gentle with unfamiliar people. She likes to be stroked and loved with the people she trusts.

Olivia has shown no allergies, intolerances or issues with any foods whilst in rescue.Adopters will have to understand that olivia may be a little unsettled within the first few days of entering a new home with an unfamiliar routine and people.

Giving her time to decompress and adjust to her new home is key in supporting her. She is good with sensible, children 10+ and has no known health issues.

We would advise having Olivia is restrained by either a crate or seatbelt/headrest attachment as in accordance with the law and so that she does not try to bolt when trying to take her out of the car. He needs a calm and loving home who will give Olivia lots of love and affection.

A gentle home with not lots of comings and goings. You must have the facilities, time, financial means, knowledge and skills necessary to ensure a good standard of care. We require an APPLICATION and HOMECHECK.

Olivia is spayed, DHPPi/RL and KC vaccinated, and microchipped. She will be flea and worm treated. She will travel on approved transport directly to her home address. Rescue back up and support available.

name: Dobby
description:
Just look at this wonderful, smiley girl Dobby.

Dobby is a delightful 3-year-old female Cross-Breed.

For more than a year she has been at the new shelter in Bosnia but prior to this, she was at the old shelter on the dump where the conditions were unimaginable. Despite this Dobby is described as the most beautiful girl who shouldn’t be spending her life in a shelter.

Due to her colour many people in Bosnia don’t give her a second look but if they knew just how wonderful she was then her fur colour wouldn’t matter.

She loves to be stroked and runs to everyone for love and affection whilst always having a smile on her face. She gets along perfectly with all the other dogs and she shows no aggression when she sees a cat although she doesn’t live with cats in the shelter.

How could anyone not want to love this girl?

We would love to talk to anyone who is interested in giving Dobby a loving home:

Currently in Bosnia Dogs from Bosnia have to quarantine in the U.K.

48hrs before arriving to their home. Application and checks apply.

name: Amira
description:
Amira, a four-year-old female cross-breed, stands at a height of 57cm. Rescued from a public shelter in Romania, she now resides in a private shelter while awaiting her forever home.

Despite her past challenges, Amira is described as super friendly and gentle, enjoying human contact and affection. She walks nicely on a lead and relishes her time outside the kennel.

For Amira, a patient and experienced home with knowledge of caring for big dogs is preferred. She understands that the journey to the UK is lengthy and will require time to decompress in her new environment.

A secure garden where she can play safely is also on her wishlist.

Amira has been fully vaccinated, blood-tested, spayed, and received flea and worm treatments. She also has a microchip and is registered in the Recs system.

With her own passport and import papers, she is ready to travel to the UK upon approval.

For those interested in welcoming Amira into their home, reaching out to the admin team is encouraged.

They will guide prospective adopters through the process and provide support along the adoption journey.

name: Carrie
description:
Carrie is a 18 month old pup who we think will grow to be medium sized but parentage is unknown. We met Carrie in our last trip to Botosani public shelter in Romania.

She is such a sweet girl and really looked for fuss when we entered the pen. Given the time and space, she will be such a loving girl.

Carrie would be happy with or without a resident dog and would be suitable with children 10+.

name: Zara
description:
Zara is a 4-year-old female Mioritic shepherd cross, currently residing in Romania.

She stands tall at 67 centimeters and weighs 38 kilograms. Big and beautiful, Zara was rescued from a public shelter in Romania and is now in a private foster home.

She requires a dog-experienced household due to her past experiences.

Zara has been tested with the resident cat and showed no signs of aggression towards him.

However, her history prior to and during her stay in the shelter remains unknown, so patience and understanding are key in her new home.

It’s important for her adopters to be prepared to go at her pace and be experienced with rescue dogs.

Despite her past, Zara has been making great progress in her foster home.

She deserves a safe and loving environment in her next chapter of life.

name: Tina
description:
Introducing our very special graveyard pup Tina.

Tina is a 1 year old 14 kg female Cross-Breed.

Vaccinated, Blood tested for disease, microchipped, Spayed, flea and worm treated.

History:Tina was rescued as a young pup with her brothers after being discarded in a graveyard almost a year ago now.

She has stayed in a private shelter, seeking a home.

Personality:Tina is an outgoing girl who enjoys company and attention. She is a loveable soul who will make a great companion.

Meeting new people:Tina has found no worries meeting new people in the shelter or visiting the vet.

Dog test:Tina lives happily with her siblings in a private shelter.

Cat test:Tina would prefer a house without cats because she doesn’t live with any at this time.

Home alone:Tina doesn’t currently live in a home environment. Adopters will have to understand though that She may be a little unsettled within the first few days of entering a new home with a new routine and new people.

Giving her time to decompress and adjust to her new home is key in supporting her.

Health problems:Tina was pretty ill when she regrettably contracted distemper when she was younger. Thank goodness, Tina received supportive care and recovered. She is now well and has undergone testing, and there are no long-term repercussions from this.

Home needsA home with children over 15 years of age. This includes visiting and resident children to the property INCLUDING. grandchildren, nieces/nephews, friends’ children. No cats as she isn’t used to them. Secure garden.

Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK APPLICATIONS and CHECKS apply.

name: Maggie
description:
Maggie is a small to medium-sized crossbreed of around 11 years old fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Maggie came to us from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She had been in there almost all her life and her existence in the dire place had left her shut down and afraid of humans.

It’s taken a long time but Maggie is now a cheeky and confident girl in her foster home. She is still afraid of people she doesn’t know but is comfortable being touched and groomed by those she knows. She is not yet asking for fuss and attention but this will come later in a more one-to-one environment.

Maggie has met cats and was fine with them.

Maggie needs a home experienced with nervous dogs. She is enjoying her walks now and would like quite an active exercise routine.

It is essential that Maggie lives with at least one other dog so please do not apply unless you have a dog full time in your home. Maggie could not cope with the noise and unpredictability of small children but would be ok with dog-savvy children of ten plus.

Maggie has recently started showing an interest in toys and enjoys chewing on a Nylabone, this has been so lovely to see. She is a massive lover of food and when the treats come out or dinner is being prepared she will push her way to the front and bark, demanding hers.

Maggie often goes to an enclosed field where she can run around off-lead. She used to spend her time at these by herself but now likes to stick with the group, only falling behind if she’s found something good to sniff.

Unfortunately, Maggie had a falling out with another resident dog in her adopted home and this has caused others to initiate bullying behaviour towards Maggie and she is regularly picked on, causing her a lot of stress on a daily basis. She needs somewhere with a nice doggy friend where she can gain confidence with her humans in her own time.

name: Dony
description:
Dony is a 4 year old male Shepherd Cross “I’m a little bigger, but my soul is twice as big as my body is. I love people, and I get along great with all dogs.

I am very proud of my act of humanity. On one occasion, I donated blood for a sick friend of mine and thus saved her life.

I would be the happiest dog in the whole world if I were adopted by people with a yard and space that I could fill with my love and joy.” – Quote

name: Henry
description:
Henry is a 1-2 year old male Cross-Breed. This sweet boy, not even a fully grown dog then, wandered the streets for days.

Unlike many other dogs, Henry was not afraid of people, he walked up to each one of them hoping for a home, help, or just some food to go through another day.

His fate turned the day one of the S-PAS association volunteers saw him, stopped the car and just jumped in.

This story best describes what helped him survive alone, he took no chances, and when he saw an opportunity he went for it!

So what strange luck would it be for Henry if someone gave him a chance and did not miss out on an opportunity as great as him?

Henry is a middle-sized dog that needs a firm authority life companion. Ever since he was found on the street, he spent his time in foster homes.

From all the fosters we have had clear feedback about him not being an aggressive dog, just a baby in need of love and care that did not have the opportunity to learn how to behave during his life on the street.

Henry shared his living space with other dogs and children and did not have any issues.

Also, he knows well how to behave in a house, but as any dog, needs some time to adjust to new spaces and people.

In the photos presented, you can see him with short fur, but his hair grows very scruffy, terrier-like, but softer.

Henry is vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, neutered, and microchipped. He is currently located in Croatia Back up in the U.K. – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK Application, process and checks apply.

name: Lola
description:
Lola is a 4 year old female Hound Cross. She is currently living in Bosnia Back up in the U.K. – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK Application, Process and Checks apply.

Lola is suitable for life with the other dogs and suitable for life with children 10+. NO cats, please.

“I am good-natured, cheerful, lovely and I love people very much. I get along great with other dogs and I love the time when we all play together in the yard. My wish is to be adopted by someone good, caring and of course beautiful like I am.

Adopters should be mindful of their actions and expectations, as well as be aware of the dog’s body language during any potentially stressful interactions.

Do not expect to bring home a fully adjusted dog who will require little training from you.” – Quote

name: Bobbin
description:
Bobbin is a medium sized crossbreed aged around 3 years old.

Bobbin was a puppy in the Botosani public shelter in Romania and tragically he never got picked and therefore grew up there. The filthy concrete floors and metal bars are all he’s ever known until he recently traveled to his UK foster home.

Bobbin is having an absolute blast in his new surroundings. Following his foster mum around and learning new things by the minute. He is initially a little shy with strangers as he’s not seen much of people previously but it doesn’t take long at all to win his trust.

He is now living the puppyhood he was so tragically deprived of and playing all day long. His tail never stops wagging.

Bobbin mixes very well with dogs and needs a resident dog in his forever home. He wants to play with the cat and give him kisses, but soon submits when the cat puts him firmly in his place. Bobbin could live with respectful children aged 10 plus.

name: Matteo
description:
Matteo is a medium/large crossbreed aged around 5 years old.

Matteo has come into our care recently from Roxana’s shelter in Romania. He went into the shelter as a puppy along with his mum and sister and sadly grew up there.

Matteo is a comical character who is adapting well to his new life but still has a lot of new experiences to encounter. He has a whole catalog of facial expressions that make us smile.

He is not very brave when encountering new things but after a few repeats of them he loses his fears and is really starting to enjoy and be fascinated by life outside of the shelter.

He gets on well with other dogs and would like to live with at least one other dog in his forever home. He can live with respectful children aged ten plus.

He will need patience and guidance while he builds up confidence out in the big wide world. He is affectionate and cheeky with people he knows well and will make a fab addition to his lucky new family.

name: Dottie
description:
Did you ever see anyone as beautiful as Dottie? Look at all that fluff.

Dottie is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed.

She is vaccinated, Blood tested for disease, spayed, microchipped, flea and worm treated

Why is Dottie in shelter: Dottie currently resides in a shelter located in Romania after she was abandoned in a cemetery with her siblings. She was just a tiny baby then but now she is a big girl and is more than ready to spread her wings and find an understanding family.

Personality: Dottie is the most shy out of the siblings with unfamiliar people With her carers Dottie is very loving and sweet. Dottie enjoys walks and is totally lead trained.

A few nights ago there was a storm in the area and Dottie was afraid of this. In situations she finds uncomfortable, she will need support and reassurance.

Home needs: Dottie needs an understanding, dog-experienced home who will not rush her into any situations she could find overwhelming. It’s imperative that steps are taken slowly to gain her trust whilst she adjusts to a new way of living.

Dottie has never lived in a home and will need support from her new family with toilet training and time to adjust to a home environment and all the unknown items we have in our houses.

Health: Sadly like her siblings Dottie contracted distemper when she was little, thankfully she was treated with supportive care and survived. She doesn’t have any neurological problems but her teeth were affected due to the distemper.

They don’t affect her in any way and she is eating without problem but they will need monitoring as she gets older. Dottie is now blood tested and clear.

Rbu – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK APPLICATION and CHECKS apply.

name: Cindy
description:
Cindy is a small to medium sized crossbreed aged around three to four years – Cindy fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Cindy and her sister were placed in a box and dumped next to a train track when they were a few weeks old. Thankfully they were saved before the inevitable happened and taken to a safe shelter.

Unfortunately they were not picked for adoption and so grew up there and only now have we been able to offer her a space in a UK foster home.

Cindy is a friendly and happy girl who will simply need to gain life experience when she finds her forever home. She is kind and friendly with other dogs but could also live as the only dog in the home.

She would like a calmish home environment with no children under the age of twelve.

name: Spud
description:
Spud is a 4 year old male Cross-Breed. He is described as an all-around great dog who loves human contact.

Spud comes alive when he is out exploring and is at his happiest being out on the field.

Spud is definitely up for adventure with his new family. Spud is friendly with females and males and enjoys spending time with his foster daughter.

Spud recently met the resident horse with no issues or aggressive behaviour. What a brave boy.

This intelligent boy is going to make a family extremely happy. Whoever adopts Spud will feel such joy with him.

Spud is on the smaller side of medium with a long coat. He currently lives in private foster in Romania but is ready to find a family in the U.K. full rescue backup in the U.K.

name: Mr. Bean
description:
Mr. Bean is a medium sized crossbreed aged around 4 years old.

Mr. Bean arrived at the Botosani public with his mum and siblings when he was a tiny pup. The rest of his family all got adopted but he wasn’t chosen and so he was left to grow up in the shelter. He is now in a UK foster home and learning about life out side of a pen.

Mr. Bean is a comical character whose natural curiosity is carrying him through all the lessons he has to learn to catch up on what most dogs would learn from a much younger age. He is super keen to please and will simply need to gain experience when he moves to his forever home.

He gets on brilliantly with other dogs and having a canine companion would really help him to have around in his forever home, he could be the only dog with a little more time and patience from his adoptive family. My. Bean could live with respectful children aged eight plus. He is a delightful character who deserves all the love in the world now that he’s finally out of the shelter.

name: Lizzie
description:
Lizzie is a medium sized crossbreed aged around 6 years old.

Lizzie came into our care around a year ago after we met her on a trip to the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She was scarily emaciated back then and we did wonder if she would survive long enough for us to get her to the UK. She did make it onto the bus and arrived safely in her uk foster home.

Lizzie was always curious about people and happy to be around them but was initially afraid to be actually touched but is now a very affectionate and loving girl with huge enthusiasm for human contact.

Lizzie enjoys the company of other dogs and would prefer another, full time resident, dog in her forever home. She would be ok as an only dog if someone was home most of the time and she had plenty of interaction with other dogs out on walks.

Lizzie is a playful and cheery girl who enjoys her walks. She can be wary of tall men in the home until she gets to know them well. Lizzie is fine with the safe rescue cat and can live with children aged twelve plus.

name: Lola
description:
Lola is a 5-6 year old female Cross-Breed. She currently resides in private foster in Romania.

Lola’s current foster home describes her as follows: Lola is a cheerful dog who enjoys running, going for walks, and playing with her son. She is gentle and outgoing.

She enjoys cuddling with friends and being stroked. She appreciates every bit of attention she receives from them. This sweetheart is also social with youngsters, and she takes care of them peacefully.

Lola walks well on a leash. She was in the first foster home for a short time where she was clean in the house. She is good with sensible, children 10+ and has no known health issues.

We would advise having Lola restrained by either a crate or seatbelt/headrest attachment in accordance with the law so that she does not try to bolt when trying to take her out of the car.

Lola is spayed, DHPPi/RL and KC vaccinated, and microchipped. Blood tested for disease, Lola will be flea and worm treated. She will travel on approved transport directly to her home address. Rescue back up and support available U.K. – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

name: Charlene
description:
Charlene is a 3/4 year old female medium sized cross breed who is currently enjoying life in her foster home in Norwich, East Anglia.

She was rescued from a kill shelter in Romania and subsequently taken to a private shelter, where she was given a second chance at finding the loving home she deserves.

Charlene is described as a sweet and friendly girl with a lovely temperament, making her a potentially wonderful addition to a family looking to welcome a new dog into their lives.

Her friendly nature and adaptable personality mean that she is expected to fit comfortably into a variety of home environments, provided she receives the love, care and attention she needs.

Since arriving in her foster home, Charlene has been mixing well with the other dogs and has shown that she is comfortable sharing her surroundings with them.

She could happily join a household that already has other dogs, but she would also be equally suited to a home where she is the only dog, enjoying all the attention for herself.

This flexibility means she could be considered by a range of potential adopters, whether they already have dogs or are looking for a companion of their own.

Charlene could also live with respectful children aged eight and over, making her a possible match for a family with older children who understand how to behave appropriately around dogs.

With her sweet and friendly nature, good interactions with the dogs in her foster home and ability to suit a household with or without other dogs, Charlene has plenty to offer.

She is now looking for a permanent home where she can settle in, become part of the family and enjoy the security and affection of a loving environment.

Most harnesses are not escape proof, but harnesses with a strap behind the rib cage (e.g. Ruffwear Webmaster or Perfect Fit Harnesses) are safer.

name: Lenny
description:
Lenny is a 1-2 year old male Shepherd Cross. “I am looking for a family of my own. I currently live in a private foster with my rescuer Kerala.

I like human contact very, very much. I like to be stroked and fussed as much as possible.

My rescuer describes me as such a lovely boy who only wants love. ? I would like very much a nice garden to explore and play in.

I am healthy, and happy and have no known allergies or food intolerances. I am not accustomed to living with cats so it’s best my home doesn’t have cats. I live with many other dogs of all ages and sizes.

I don’t live with small children in my foster. I have no bite history or concerning behaviour whilst being in foster.

I don’t know a lead yet so I will need some support with this in my new home, along with house training. I am not accustomed to seeing lots of traffic so will need support with this when walking.” – Quote

name: Nella
description:
Nella is a 1-2 year old female Cross-Breed. She was rescued from the old shelter in Bosnia where the conditions were dismal.

Nella now resides in the new state-of-the-art shelter established by the network for animals.

Nella is a happy girl who does love people and their attention. Nella must find a family who has the time to give her and isn’t away from home for long periods as this could upset her.

Nella enjoys the company of her kennel Mates running and playing. She also enjoys toys and playing games and when she’s not enjoying this she loves nothing more than a cuddle from her human friends.

Nella is a healthy girl with no known allergies or intolerances. She is vaccinated, blood tested, brucellosis tested, flea and worm treated.

Nella is spayed and microchipped. She has a secure garden with at least 5ft fencing and continued training and support. No cats as she doesn’t meet them or live with them.

Nella can live with children 10+. Dog experienced home who age understanding and won’t expect an Andrew pup to walk through their door. She is a rescue and needs time to decompress and learn all about her new world.

name: Dony
description:
Meet Dony, the gentle giant with an even bigger heart. Dony is a 5 year old male Sarplaninac Cross, weighing around 50 kilograms and standing 75 centimeters tall. Despite his impressive size, he’s calm, kind, and completely non-demanding.

He came from an old shelter where life was far from kind, yet somehow he kept his gentle nature. He was named Dony after donating blood to a sick dog and saving its life — a true hero in every sense.

Dony gets along with everyone. He doesn’t bother with other dogs or cats and greets people with quiet warmth. He walks beautifully on a lead, enjoys calm company, and never asks for much.

Although he looks like a Sarplaninac type, he has no guarding instincts. He simply loves people and peace. What he needs now is a loving home where he can finally rest and be cherished for the wonderful, stable soul that he is.

Could you give this gentle giant the home he has waited for so patiently?

name: Finn
description:
Finn is a 18 month old crossbreed pup who we believe will grow to be medium sized. Finn fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Finn has come into our care recently from the Boto?ani public shelter in Romania. He is initially quite hand shy with new people but his confidence is growning daily.

He is much braver when he has an adult dog to shadow around and we would therefore need to find him a home with at least one other dog in permanent residence.

He is mixing well with the safe rescue cat and will need a home with children no younger than twelve.

He will need all the usual training and care that all pups need and adopters should expect peeing, poohing, chewing and potentially sleepless nights until work is put into training them out of it.

name: Neddy
description:
