Neddy is a medium sized crossbreed aged around 18 months old. Neddy fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Neddy was part of a litter that were found abandoned somewhere in Corbeanca, Romania, in a field. No mum with them. A lady contacted rescuers and begged for help… Bianca took them to her shelter.

The only girl left for Belgium, the daughter of the lady who found them adopted her. One boy left for Germany.

Dave arrived a couple of months ago and was successfully adopted and now Neddy has arrived along with the other two remaining siblings to find their happy ever afters.

Neddy is a very sweet and playful boy who is loving the adventure of the change to a UK foster home. He’s having great fun playing with other dogs and humans alike.

He’s having could live with other dogs or as an only dog. Loves his toys and fuss and walks nicely on a lead. He could live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Muffin
description:
Meet Muffin, an 8 year old female Cross-Breed with the sweetest heart and a story that’ll melt yours.

She weighs around 25 kilograms, stands 48 centimeters tall, and is a little on the chubby side — but that just adds to her charm.

Calm by nature and gentle with everyone she meets, Muffin loves people, gets along beautifully with other dogs and cats, and walks nicely on a lead.

She spent six long years living around a landfill, surviving on scraps and the kindness of strangers.

When the new shelter opened, she finally had a safe place to rest, but what she truly dreams of is a person of her own.

Muffin is more soft-hearted than dominant, always choosing peace over conflict. What she needs now is love, patience, and a quiet home where she can finally feel she belongs.

After everything she’s lived through, Muffin deserves her happy ending — a warm bed, gentle hands, and a forever friend.

Could you be the one to show Muffin what home really means?

name: Harvey
description:
Harvey is a medium sized crossbreed on very short legs, he looks like he could be Labrador and corgi amongst other things. He is believed to be around eight years old. Harvey fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Harvey has joined us recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania where he and his father and siblings spent some years. Harvey and Mason are the last of the family to come to us here.

Harvey is a quiet boy who has taken to domestic life far quicker than we expected. We are already being treated to tail wags and he’s approaching for fuss.

In the weeks ahead he will continue to grow in confidence but is already enjoying his new world away from his cell in the shelter. He would like another dog for company in his forever home and could live with respectful aged twelve plus.

name: Jemma
description:
Jemma is a medium sized crossbreed aged a year old. Jemma fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Jemma has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She is a sweet, affectionate and playful girl who will simply need a bit of basic training and new experiences.

She mixes well with the other dogs in her foster home but could also be the only dog in her forever home.

She could live with respectful children aged 10 plus.

name: Hovis
description:
Hovis is a medium sized crossbreed aged around 8 years old.

We met Hovis on the last day of our trip to Botosani public shelter in Romania in March 2024. He so nearly missed being seen amongst the 800 prisoners there until at that eleventh hour his enquisitive and cheeky face appeared in the pen next door.

He was in with some very old and grumpy dogs and had been for some time. He finally boarded the van to the UK last September and has been awaiting his forever home.

Hovis is a sweet and affectionate boy who will play for hours with his canine friends in his foster home. He absolutely loves his walks but does pull a little on the lead so will need further training, he has a fabulous time when we take him to a secure field.

He loves to play with toys and would like another playful dog in his forever home if possible.

Hovis would like an adult home environment and is perfectly fine with cats.

name: Verity
description:
Verity is a smallish whippet like crossbreed aged two to three years old. Verity fostered Poringland Norfolk.

Verity has joined us recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She is a quiet and shy girl with the whippet sensitive nature.

She mixes well with the other dogs in her foster home but likes a quiet life and would not enjoy living with boisterous or bouncy dogs.

She would like a calm and quiet home environment where she can relax and enjoy peace. She would like an adult home but wouldn’t be a problem with children visiting.

name: Bunney
description:
Bunney, a 10 year old female Cross-Breed, is the definition of the perfect companion dog. A gentle, affectionate older girl with a heart full of love, Bunney is looking for a family to share her golden years with.

At 12 years old, she has mastered the art of companionship and is happiest when she’s close to her people.

Bunney adores humans of all ages and loves nothing more than leisurely walks, car rides, beach visits and accompanying her family on outings.

Whether it’s a pub lunch, a restaurant visit or a weekend away, Bunney is always delighted to come along, especially if it means meeting new people and collecting plenty of fuss and cuddles.

She is calm, gentle and affectionate, with a constantly wagging tail and an adorable wiggly bottom.

Once she has greeted everyone and received the attention she deserves, she is perfectly content to curl up somewhere s oft and snooze while life carries on around her.

Bunney gets along wonderfully with other dogs and enjoys canine company. She is also cat-friendly and is happy sharing her home with feline friends, although she does enjoy keeping a close eye on what they’re doing around the house and the garden.

Walking is one of Bunney’s favourite activities. She walks beautifully on lead, has excellent recall and enjoys gentle sniffy adventures where she can explore at her own pace.

While she may occasionally break into a run, she’s much more interested in spending time with her humans than rushing anywhere.

After a difficult start to life, Bunney has blossomed into an incredibly loving and grateful dog. Rescued after being neglected when she was no longer needed for breeding, she is now healthy, fully recovered and thriving.

She is ready to show her forever family just how much love a rescue dog can give.

If you’re looking for a loyal best friend, a pub companion, a beach buddy and a champion cuddler all wrapped up in one beautiful dog, Bunney could be the perfect match for you.

name: Tsexof
description:
Meet Tsexof – a gentle soul with the happiest smile!

Tsexof (pronounced Chekhov) is a lovely 7-year-old cross-breed boy with a wonderfully gentle nature and a smile that’s hard to resist!

Having previously lived with a family, Tsexof sadly found himself without a home and has now spent over a year in boarding kennels. He’s been patiently waiting for another chance to enjoy the comforts of family life.

Tsexof is a calm, affectionate and easygoing boy who absolutely loves human company. He’ll happily wander over to say hello, hoping for a gentle fuss and some attention.

He’s never demanding, just genuinely happy to be around people who show him kindness.

He’s not particularly interested in toys or energetic games, preferring the simpler pleasures in life. A leisurely walk, a little exploring in the garden and then a cosy spot on the sofa beside his favourite people would suit him perfectly.

Despite his relaxed nature, Tsexof is healthy, enjoys his walks and behaves beautifully on the lead.

He’s also very sociable with other dogs and happily shares his kennel with a more energetic companion without being bothered by the difference in their personalities.

Having lived with children previously, Tsexof could make a lovely family companion in a home with respectful children aged 6 and over.

He’s also reported to be comfortable around cats, so a home with feline companions could be considered with careful introductions.

His ideal home would offer a calm, loving environment with a secure garden where he can explore at his own pace. He would be equally happy with a quieter household or a family that enjoys a more relaxed pace of life.

As he’s spent some time in kennels, his new family should be prepared to give him patience and guidance while he readjusts to living in a home, including establishing his toilet routine.

Tsexof is neutered, vaccinated, has no known health issues and is ready to travel to his new home.

After more than a year of kennel life, this sweet, smiling boy deserves somewhere soft to sleep, people to love and the security of knowing he’s finally home.

Could you be the person who puts that smile on his face every day?

name: Leo
description:
Meet Leo, a 2 year old male Shepherd Cross with a heart as big as his smile.

He’s about 62 centimeters tall and weighs 29 kilograms — a handsome, well-built boy full of life and love.

Found wandering the city streets, Leo was lost but hopeful, greeting everyone he met with a wagging tail and bright eyes.

Leo is affectionate, intelligent, and very people-oriented. He loves human company and thrives on interaction.

Quick to learn, he walks nicely on a lead and enjoys having a task or some training time with his person.

He gets along wonderfully with other dogs and is gentle with cats.

His happy, playful energy makes him perfect for an active home that enjoys walks, adventures, and a loyal companion always by their side.

Behind his shepherd looks is a kind, devoted soul who simply wants to belong and love someone who will love him back.

Would you open your home to Leo? He’s ready to give his heart completely.

name: Milo
description:
Meet Milo – a fun-loving boy with a zest for life!

If you’re looking for a playful, energetic companion who loves having fun, Milo might just be your perfect match!

Milo is a handsome, medium-sized Pointer-type crossbreed, born in June 2024. He’s a happy, friendly young boy who loves people, especially when they’re ready to join in his favourite activity – playing!

Give Milo a ball to chase and he’s in his element! He absolutely loves running after toys, playing fetch and having someone to share the fun with.

He’s also quite happy entertaining himself with a toy, and when there’s a chance for some affection, he’ll happily enjoy a fuss and a few head scratches too.

Milo is sociable with other dogs and gets along well with his kennel companion, Bella. He could happily share his new home with another friendly, compatible dog, although he’d be equally happy having his family’s attention to himself.

Rescued earlier this year in poor condition with an injured paw, Milo has made a wonderful recovery. Watching him happily racing around after his ball today, you’d hardly imagine he’d had such a difficult start.

Milo is looking for an active family who can give him the exercise, attention and enrichment that a young dog like him needs.

A good-sized, secure garden where he can run, play and enjoy his favourite ball games is important, along with plenty of opportunities for interesting walks and adventures.

As Milo hasn’t had much experience of walking on a lead or living in a family home, he’ll need patience, guidance and ongoing positive training as he learns about his new life.

An experienced owner familiar with energetic hunting-type breeds would be wonderful, but a committed first-time owner with an active lifestyle could also be a great match.

Milo could be suitable for a family with older, dog-savvy children aged 12+. His compatibility with cats is currently unknown, but testing can be arranged if required.

Milo is neutered, vaccinated and ready to find a family who will give him the active, happy life he deserves.

If you’ve got a secure garden, an active lifestyle and a ball ready to throw, Milo would love to meet you!

name: Riddick
description:
Riddick is a handsome 4-year-old Rottweiler with a big personality, an affectionate side and, once he knows he is safe with you, a real love of being close to his people.

Sadly, Riddick hasn’t always had reason to trust humans. He came into rescue after being seized by Veterinary Services, having reportedly been mistreated and left without enough food. Understandably, those experiences have left their mark.

When Riddick first meets someone new he can be wary and guarded, particularly around men. He needs people who understand that his trust has to be earned rather than expected.

Give him the time and space to work you out, approach him calmly and let him decide when he is ready, and a very different dog begins to appear.

With the people he trusts, Riddick is affectionate, playful and loves human company. As you can see from his photos, once you have made it into his trusted circle, this big lad is quite happy getting as close to you as physically possible!

He is food motivated, enjoys playing with toys and already has some great foundations for life in a home. He walks well on the lead, travels well in the car, is house trained and crate trained, and knows some commands.

Riddick is also good with other dogs and could potentially share his home with a suitable canine companion following successful introductions. He cannot live with cats.

Because of his history and the time he needs to build trust, we are looking for an experienced, patient adopter who will allow the relationship to develop at Riddick’s pace.

We would particularly want any men in the household to understand that he may need more time with them initially.

His suitability with children has not yet been established, so we would not place him into a home with young children without further assessment.

Riddick is Leishmania positive and has received treatment. This will be discussed fully with anyone interested in adopting him so that they understand his ongoing needs.

Riddick doesn’t need someone to feel sorry for him. He needs someone prepared to understand him.

Someone who won’t rush those first introductions, who will give him consistency and security, and who will let him discover that he doesn’t need to protect himself anymore.

For the right person, we think the reward will be a deeply affectionate, loyal companion who has finally found somewhere he can completely relax and call home.

name: Manolis
description:
Manolis is a 8 month old male Cross-Breed.

This pup is just the full package, confident, social, playful, happy, loving and a goofball!

Manolis is very social, loves to meet other pups and dogs and is respectful.

With dogs he knows well, he is happy to initiate a game and even happier when the invite is accepted.

This boy loves cuddles and will happily lay for hours receiving ear and belly rubs, he will reward you with kisses.

Manolis also loves water. He loves his paddling pool, so I suspect he will enjoy dips in the sea, lake or river.

He’s also a fun loving goofball, is very happy doing zoomies alone or being chased.

name: Meggie
description:
Meggie is a medium sized female crossbreed aged around 6 years old.

Meggie was brought to the UK from Bosnia back in October 2022 by another rescuer. She came with her siblings, all were scared but Meggie was the most afraid and never came out from the back of a crate in her foster home.

We have worked with the rescue many times and they asked if we could help her.

It’s taken a very long time but Meggie is only now ready to find her own home.

She is still wary of strangers and unlikely to show herself well when potential adopters come to see her, but actually if someone could just give her a chance she’s very “normal” once she’s settled and gotten to know everyone.

In her foster home she is very playful and affectionate. She walks nicely on a lead but can be a bit jumpy in new places and situations. She continues to grow in confidence though and we believe that with the one to one time she will receive in her forever home all of her nervousness will go over time.

Meggie will need another permanent resident dog in her forever home, she simply wouldn’t cope as an only dog. She will need an adult home environment that’s not too hectic. She has a lovely character once relaxed and will make someone a very loyal and loving family addition with a little kindness and patience.

name: Jerry
description:
Jerry is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed, wonderfully affectionate, fun-loving boy with plenty of personality and an enormous amount of love to give.

He’s a happy, energetic dog who loves nothing more than racing around the yard and enjoying a good session of zoomies. Once he’s finished burning off some of that energy, though, Jerry’s softer side quickly appears.

He absolutely loves people and thrives on human attention. His carers describe him as a very friendly and loving boy with a wonderful character. He follows them around the yard, seeks them out for affection and is always happy to stop for cuddles and fuss.

Jerry certainly isn’t shy about asking for attention either! He’ll happily stand up for a cuddle, lean his whole body into you and make it very clear when he thinks you should be giving him some love.

With his playful energy and affectionate nature, Jerry would be a lovely match for someone looking for a dog they can really share their life with.

He would enjoy a home where he can have plenty of exercise, play and stimulation, alongside the human companionship he clearly values so much.

Jerry has lots of enthusiasm for life, but behind the zoomies is an incredibly loving boy who just wants people of his own to follow around, play with and cuddle.

If you’re looking for a fun, affectionate companion who will bring plenty of energy and even more love into your home, Jerry could be your boy.

name: Chivas
description:
CHIVAS, a gorgeous and friendly 3 year old jura hound. As you know, jura hounds have the best characters; shy but gentle, and not a mean bone in their bodies.

Chivas was found and rescued with bad leg injuries.

He had orthopaedic surgeries, and, one year later, it’s as if nothing has happened! His recovery has been amazing; he can run, play and enjoy his life like all dogs.

Chivas is healthy- blood work all clear. Current weight 11 kg- small to medium size.

Chivas is currently in Cyprus looking for a home in UK. He will be neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, come with his own pet passport and rescue back up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Rammos
description:
Ramos is a very lovely 10-year-old cross-breed gentleman who still enjoys the simple pleasures of life: going for walks, sniffing around, spending time with people and, of course, cuddles.

He is a slow walker, but he enjoys every minute of being outside and discovering the world at his own pace.

He gets along with most dogs, provided they respect his age and don’t jump all over him. He has even been good with some puppies who seem to understand that he isn’t interested in their endless games.

Ramos has his own character and is certainly not a submissive old boy! He knows how to stand his ground when necessary.

He is friendly with adults and children, too, although children should be well-mannered and understand that an older dog needs his peace and personal space.

Ramos would appreciate a calm, respectful environment where he can enjoy com panionship without being disturbed.

As a senior dog, he has some difficulties walking and needs a little extra care. His weight should be carefully monitored, and he would benefit from appropriate vitamins and supplements to support his joints and general wellbeing.

He didn’t enjoy the hot weather, and we suspect he wouldn’t be particularly comfortable during cold, wet winter days either.

We cannot help wondering about his past. Ramos was probably once a hunting dog, and perhaps he was discarded when age caught up with him and he could no longer do the job expected of him.

We will never know for sure, but it is heartbreaking to think that an older dog might be left behind simply because he is no longer useful.

And now, another winter is approaching. The thought of Ramos spending his senior years in a cold, damp kennel, instead of on a warm sofa beside someone who loves him, is truly sad.

Ramos doesn’t need adventures or a demanding lifestyle anymore. He n eeds a comfortable bed, gentle walks, a few cuddles, kind people and the security of knowing he belongs somewhere.

name: Apollon
description:
Apollon is a5 year old male Belgian Shepherd.

You were just a puppy when someone bought you, almost as if you were a toy.

They played with you, trained you, used you and even gave you a prestigious name: Alpha Dark of C.A. And then, when they got tired of you and perhaps wanted a new “toy”, you were no longer wanted. At just 5.5 years old, you were already old for them.

Somewhere along the way, you also lost an eye. We don’t know what happened to you or what you went through.

But what we do know is that the family who once chose you abandoned you as easily as if you were nothing, and you ended up in a small cage in a municipal pound.

You are a magnificent Belgian Malinois, and we will describe you exactly as we know you: a fantastic, well-behaved, healthy dog who deserves nothing but the best.

And the first thing we wanted to give you was a new name. No more Alpha Dark. You are Apollon. Our Apollon.

Apollon is 5.5 years old, castrated and healthy. He has only one eye, but this does not affect him at all. He knows commands, walks beautifully on the leash, listens to your voice and, when you call him, comes and sits next to you like a true protector.

He will be the most loyal friend to the person who gives him a family.

Apollon would be a wonderful match for an active person who knows and loves the breed. In return, you will have a loyal companion and protector by your side.

He does not react to stray cats while walking, although he would prefer not to be friends with them. He has also met a female dog and was good with her.

However, honestly, we believe he would be happiest as the only pet in the home. He is the kind of dog who forms a very strong bond with his person, and you can truly feel his beautiful, majestic energy.

We desperately want to see Apollon out of that municipal cage and into the life he deserves.

Apollon is currently in Cyprus looking for a home in UK. He will be neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, have his own pet passport and rescue back up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue. Adoption fee and home check required.

name: Alex
description:
Alex, 23 week old male Cross-Breed, was found together with his five siblings and their mum.

Instead of growing up in a warm home surrounded by love, attention and new experiences, these little ones are spending their puppyhood in a shelter.

Sadly, they don’t receive nearly as much affection and individual care as puppies need at this important age.

Each of the puppies has their own personality.

Some are more active, curious and brave, always ready to explore, while others are a little quieter and more cautious and need some extra time to feel confident.

Alex, just like his siblings, is growing and learning every day.

What he needs most now is a family of his own — someone who will show him what life outside the shelter can be like and give him the love, patience and care every puppy deserves.

Every one of these babies is unique, and every one of them deserves a home.

name: Tequila
description:
Meet Tequila, a beautiful medium-sized Staffy cross girl who is around 8 years young!

Don’t let her age fool you—while she is generally a relaxed, medium-to-low energy girl who loves nothing more than laying down for cuddles and a long nap, she still has a wonderful playful side.

She absolutely adores playing with toys, especially balls, and her favorite place in the world is curled up right next to you on the sofa.

Tragically, Tequila was returned to us at the end of July 2025 through no fault of her own following a severe family breakdown.

After enduring significant hardship, she ended up living in a car with her dedicated owner before he had no choice but to surrender her back to us so she could find safety.

Tequila is wonderful with people and shows no aggression whatsoever. She walks okay on the lead, though she can be strong and gets excited by jumping up to greet you.

After everything she has been through, she is looking for a patient, stable home where she can finally feel secure.

Best suited to a home with older children/teenagers (due to her strength and enthusiastic jumping).

A cozy sofa, plenty of cuddles, and someone to play ball with!

She has so much loyalty and affection to give. If you can offer this resilient girl the safe, peaceful sanctuary she truly deserves, please get in touch!

name: Messi
description:
I’m a shy but happy boy with a soft heart and a gentle spirit, looking for a calm home where I can grow in confidence at my own pace.

I’m a handsome hound mix approx 4 years old, with a beautiful coat of white and warm browns. I may be unsure in new situations, but I’m a sweet, friendly lad who really shines when I’m with other dogs.

Canine friends help me feel relaxed, and I do wonderfully sharing space or playing with dogs of all types.

When people approach me, I look happy and curious, but I’m still learning to feel comfortable with close contact. I’ll take a step back if I’m unsure—but if you give me time, I’ll come to you when I’m ready.

I’m doing so well with my gentle training, and I’ve recently started allowing light touches to my face and head when I choose to come close.

I love treats (they’re a great way to my heart!), and I enjoy toys too—I don’t mind sharing them. When it’s time for handling or check-ups, I can get a little stressed, but I tolerate it, and I’m learning every day.

I have no known health issues and no history of aggression. I’m a good eater, calm around food, and have lovely manners.

A quieter home would suit me best, where I can feel safe and another dog might help build my confidence.

I’m a sweet, sensitive boy who just needs time, patience, and kindness. If you think you could be the one to help me blossom, please message this page or apply via the website.

Messi is currently in Cyprus looking for a home in UK. He will be neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, have his own pet passport and rescue back up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Jessie
description:
Meet Jessie, a 2-year-old female Cross-Breed who’s spayed, fully vaccinated, and weighs around 16 kilograms. She’s currently in a private shelter in Romania after quite literally rescuing herself back in May 2024 — talk about a girl with spirit!

Jessie is lively, affectionate, and loyal. She’s playful and thrives on interaction, exercise, and attention.

She still has some puppy-like behaviours, such as play nipping and jumping up to say hello, but with the right guidance, she’ll soon channel that energy in all the right ways.

She can happily live with other dogs or be the only dog in the home. Jessie is also friendly with people and may be suitable for a home with older children (16+) who are confident around bouncy, playful dogs.

Jessie would benefit from continued positive training and regular exercise to keep her both mentally and physically stimulated.

With consistency, she’ll grow into the amazing companion she’s already proving to be.

Home check and adoption donation apply. Full rescue backup and support are provided throughout the adoption process and for the lifetime of the dog.

name: Sissy
description:
Sissy is a 2 year old female Cross-Breed and is medium in size, weighing around 21 kilograms.

She was found wandering around a village, where she gave birth to seven puppies in the warehouse of a friend of one of the shelter’s volunteers.

Sadly, one didn’t survive, but the kind family cared for her and the puppies until they were old enough to move to the shelter.

Three of the pups were lucky enough to find homes, and the remaining three, together with their mother, came to the shelter once they were ready.

Sissy has been a wonderful and devoted mother. Now that her pups are grown, it’s her turn to find a forever home. She is a gentle dog with soulful eyes and a calm nature, happiest when she’s with people.

Friendly with both people and other dogs, Sissy walks well on a leash and has already won over all the volunteers.

Sissy is currently in Cyprus, looking for a home in the UK. She will be neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, and will have her own pet passport and rescue back-up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Lupo
description:
Hi everyone! Let me introduce myself: my name is Lupo. Lupo is a 5 year old male Cross-Breed, weighing 25 kilograms.

He’s very sweet, gentle, and sociable — a loving boy ready to find his forever home.

For three long years I’ve been living in a small, bare enclosure, never truly knowing what it means to have a home and a family.

Despite everything, I haven’t lost faith in people: I’m very affectionate, even with strangers, and I love cuddles.

I walk perfectly on a leash, I don’t pull, and I enjoy going for walks in good company.

I’m ready to start a new life: the one I’ve been dreaming of for far too long.

I’m looking for a family who will open their hearts to me and give me the chance to finally know true love — the kind that never ends.

Could you be the one to offer me this chance, even just a temporary home?

name: Storm
description:
Storm is a large-sized Old Presa Canario – approximately 3 years old.

Storm is currently in our kennels in Wrexham, North Wales.

Those of you who are local to us may recognise Storm, who has come to us from FOBK as she was struggling to cope in kennels and they were desperate to find her a lifeline.

Storm is extremely friendly & affectionate, once she gets to know you. Storm can be unsure when meeting new people and so will need slow introductions.

Please don’t let this put you off, Storm is obsessed with tennis balls and toys of any kind, she is more than happy to play until she’s worn herself out! Storm will never say no to treats, but most of all loves affection and a cuddle and then you’ve got a friend for life

Storm can be reactive around other dogs but will walk well alongside other dogs once control has been established with the handler.

She will need an adult only, pet free home who can continue to work on her reactivity and socialisation – believe me she will be well worth all the work!

Storm can be strong on the lead at times but generally walks well. She is muzzle trained and happy to walk with a muzzle.

Storm really is the sweetest girl once a bond & some trust have been established, she’ll then do anything to please you and is incredibly responsive.

We’re really hoping someone can see Storm how we see her and give her a well-deserved chance, she’s been living a kennel life for so long.

An adult only home, with no other pets is a must for Storm. This will ensure she can settle in and open herself up to become the best dog to her new family.

Trust us when we say once she knows you, you’ll have the best friend you could ask for!

A link to our adoption process can be found below:

https://celandinewoodanimalrescue.org.uk/adoption-processes/

Once we have received your application this will be reviewed by our dog team and if you are a suitable match one of our volunteers will be in touch within 7 days to discuss your application in more detail.

You will then be invited to meet the dog, and we encourage 2-3 meet & greets for you to get to know your chosen dog, we are happy to introduce you to multiple dogs on the day of they are suitable matches.

We do request all household members attend meet & greets including resident dogs.

If successful we will request a home check at this stage along with proof of identification and address. We will require written permission from a landlord for all applicants in rented accommodation.

Please note we require all resident dogs to be neutered and up to date with vaccinations before we will proceed with the adoption.

name: Mercury
description:
At 21 weeks old, handsome Mecury is one of a litter of seven born to a Pointer mum, and he is eagerly waiting for a family to call his own!

While Mercury is currently in Cyprus, his sister Terra has already settled into her UK home and is absolute proof of what wonderful dogs this litter grow up to be. Her adopters share:

“Terra is gaining confidence every day and is really sweet natured and gentle. She’s surprisingly calm and loves belly rubs and a cuddle, but is also quite independent.

She likes to follow scents, has a lot of puppy energy, and we think she’s super clever during training. We’re already sure she’s going to be a loving and loyal companion!”

Mercury shares the same clever, sweet, and loyal Pointer mix traits! He is full of loving potential and ready to bring so much joy, fun, and affection into his new home.

His sister Jupiter is booked for her UK flight in August, and Venus (along with brothers Mars, Venus, and Neptune) is hoping to join the next rescue flight on 13th September. Could you be the family he’s waiting for?

Medical & Travel: Fully vaccinated, microchipped, parasite treated, and holds his own passport.

Support: Full rescue back-up provided by Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

If you have room in your heart and home for a smart, sweet-natured boy, please get in touch with Saving Souls Animal Rescue today!

name: Lisa
description:
I’m a gentle, shy soul who is looking for a calm and loving home where I can finally feel safe and flourish.

I’m a medium-sized hound mix girl with beautiful black and brown markings, approx 4 years old. I may be a little unsure at first, but underneath my quiet nature is a playful heart—especially when I’m with other dogs!

I absolutely love canine company. Running around, playing, and turning anything into a game of tug-of-war is one of my favourite things to do.

When meeting new humans, I can be nervous and will gently move away until I understand everything is okay.

With time, patience, and a safe space to settle, I start to relax—and once I trust you, I’m a happy, sweet girl who enjoys gentle affection. I’m good with being touched and examined, and I take treats beautifully.

Being around other friendly dogs really boosts my confidence, so a home with another dog would make me feel especially comfortable.

I enjoy sharing space with canine pals and do wonderfully with them in open areas too—though super high-energy dogs can be a bit much for me!

I was found with my puppies before coming into rescue, so my past is a little uncertain. I’ve had no known health issues and I’m already neutered.

I do have some food guarding behaviours with other dogs, so I’ll need understanding humans who respect my space at mealtimes.

I’m a quiet, gentle girl who just needs patience, love, and a peaceful corner to call my own. In return, I’ll offer loyal companionship, sweetness, and the joy of watching a once-nervous heart finally blossom.

I can live with children, and I’m not bothered by them, but a calm home where I can take my time to settle would be the very best fit for me.

I would love to find my forever family soon. If you think I might be the girl for you, please message this page or apply via the website.

Lisa is currently in Cyprus looking for a home in UK. She will be neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, have her own pet passport and rescue back up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Greta
description:
I gave birth to 7 puppies that are being looked after while I rest and get treated.

I am very scared at the moment but hope that I will feel better when I’ve got use to the friendly games at the shelter.

name: Daisy
description:
“Hello, I’m Daisy. I am a medium-sized girl, just under 2 years old, and I’ve been waiting at the shelter for almost a year now. I am what you might call a ‘look-and-learn’ kind of girl—I find my courage by watching my friends.

If you see me and I don’t wag my tail right away, please know I’m just taking it all in. If my dog friends trust you, I know I can too!

I am very friendly with both people and other dogs. I truly love my canine pals—they are my greatest teachers. We spend our days chasing and playing until we find a perfect patch of sun to nap in.

Because I copy what other dogs do to find my bravery, I would love a home with another friendly dog to show me the ropes and help me settle in.

I am a gentle soul who loves the simple things: food, cuddles, and quiet walks. I might be a little shy at first, but it won’t take long for me to trust you—especially if you have a treat!

Once I know I’m safe, I’ll show you my favorite thing: my belly, ready for all the rubs you can give.

I thrive when life is quiet and the world feels secure. I promise to be the most patient, quiet companion, I just need a family of my own to help me finally blossom.

I am currently in Cyprus but ready to fly to the UK! I will be neutered, vaccinated, and microchipped with my own pet passport and full Rescue Backup from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Charlie
description:
If you’re looking for a smile that never ends and a loyal shadow to follow you around, I’m your boy. I am a total goofball—full of life, a bit silly, and always ready for a fun time!

I have plenty of energy for play, but I also have a very sweet, tender side that I love to show off when the day is done.

I am a “best of both worlds” kind of dog. While I love to be active, one of my favorite things is my quiet time. I am a world-class cuddler and nothing makes me happier than a good tummy rub!

I am so happy and relaxed when I’m with people that I sometimes “mouth” gently on my favorite humans to show my love—don’t worry, though, I’m a clever lad and I know my “gentle” command very well.

I absolutely love long walks and exploring the world. I can be a bit eager and might pull a little on the lead, but that’s just because I’m so excited to be out with you!

Recently, I went on a very long walk and got so happily exhausted that all I wanted was to stay and be loved.

It’s hard for me to go back to my kennel when our time is over; I’m a dog who truly needs his own human to save him and give him a permanent place by their side.

I’ve done really well playing with my canine friends here, and I would be very happy to live with a female dog of a similar size with a slow introduction.

Because I am such a bouncy, energetic goofball, I am looking for an active home with older children who can join in on my games and appreciate my silly, loving personality.

I am a happy, devoted boy who just needs a home where I can play hard and cuddle even harder. Could you be the person to finally take me home for good?

Charlie is currently in Cyprus looking for a home in UK. He will be neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, have his own pet passport and rescue back up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Chico
description:
MEET CHICO: THE YOUNG BOY READY FOR A FRESH START

Chico is less than a year old and a small to medium-sized Beagle cross Jack Russell Terrier. His nature is incredibly friendly, affectionate, and completely non-aggressive with people.

He has a sweet, social personality but suffers from severe separation anxiety due to a difficult past.

If you have a busy, multi-dog household, a secure garden, and plenty of time to give, Chico is the pup who desperately needs your help to rewrite his story.

Through no fault of his own, this poor boy has already been through a lifetime of upheaval, being abandoned in the mountains after a failed rehoming attempt.

Despite everything, he has settled down beautifully and grown much calmer since arriving in rescue.

Chico will thrive with the right family because he is a sweet, friendly boy who just wants to be loved. He also absolutely loves canine company. Doggy daycare previously gave him a massive boost, he loves being around other pups.

His perfect match will be a multi-dog home where he can live with at least one other young, playful dog to keep him occupied and provide companionship.

Due to his separation anxiety, he needs a family where someone is home all day with him, or who can take him to doggy daycare so he is never left alone to panic.

Because he learned to run off in the past, he also strictly needs a highly secure home with a safely fenced yard where he cannot wander.

He will be neutered, vaccinated, chipped, and treated for parasites, with his own pet passport and full rescue backup from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Pipsqueak (Pip)
description:
Pip, 6 month old female Cross-Breed, was found alongside her 9 siblings by a shelter worker at an abandoned petrol station in the buffer zone. The charity caring for Pip believes that the puppies were born there to a stray mother.

At around 6 months old and currently weighing 9kg, Pip is expected to grow into a medium-sized dog when fully grown.

She is playful, loving, friendly and full of that irresistible puppy excitement! She loves having fun and exploring but once the zoomies are over, she is more than happy to curl up for some cuddles and a well-deserved nap.

Pip is also good with other dogs and with the right introductions, can learn to live with a cat too.

And this little girl is clever! During her photoshoot, a volunteer decided to see if she could learn to sit and Pip picked it up quickly!

If you’d like more information or are interested in adopting Pip, please send us a message.

Pip is in Cyprus and is searching for a loving forever home in the UK. She will be neutered (if age appropriate), fully vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites and RBU will be provided.

name: Ria
description:
Ria has been at the shelter since June 2025 with no luck finding her forever home.

She is a big sweetheart with a gentle, affectionate nature. Around 3 years old (estimate DOB 30/06/2023) and weighing 28kg, this large girl is friendly and loving.

While she may be timid at first when meeting new people or facing new situations, she quickly warms up and shows her soft, loyal side.

Ria is playful, good with people and other dogs and loves nothing more than a good cuddle and a walk. She walks well on a leash and has low to medium energy levels.

She’s a pretty girl with a wonderful personality: playful, funny, clever and a big fan of treats. She adores attention and cuddles, often leaning against your legs.

Ria has all the best qualities combined: affectionate, loyal, intelligent and full of charm.

What Ria needs is someone to believe in her and give her the time, patience and love to let her beautiful self shine.

If you are interested in Ria, please message us.

Ria is currently in Cyprus looking for a home in UK. She is neutered, vaccinated, chipped, treated for parasites, has her own pet passport and rescue back up from Saving Souls Animal Rescue.

name: Linda
description:
Linda was found as a stray by a long-time animal lover and former municipal carer who has spent years dedicating his life to rescue and has supported our work in the past.

Linda is an incredibly joyful and affectionate girl. She’s especially happy when she gets out of her kennel, being with people truly lights her up, and she loves showing her excitement and affection.

She gets along well with other dogs, walks beautifully on the lead, and even knows how to sit politely for a treat. She really is a wonderful companion who just needs someone to give her a chance.

Linda is currently in Cyprus and is searching for a loving forever home in Cyprus or the UK. She is neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, treated for parasites, and RBU will be provided.

name: Sam
description:
Sam is a medium sized crossbreed born in March this year. Sam fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Sam and Vic along with their mother, Via were rescued from the Bolde?ti-Sc?ieni public shelter in Romania.

A woman saved them, but her husband caused a scene when she brought them home, so she took them to a place where they owned a vineyard (which is why I named the mother “Via”).

She kept the mother chained up so she wouldn’t wander off, and Sam and Vic would stay quietly by her side. The woman would go to bring them food, but she couldn’t always make it there, so most of the time they were left hungry.

Luckily they were offered a space at Stella’s shelter and have spent the last few months there.

Sam is a comical and chatty boy who is very loving and affectionate. He is mixing well with the other dogs in his foster home and, ideally but not essentially, would like another dog to play with in his forever home.

He could live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Oscar
description:
Oscar is a 5 year old medium-sized male Istrian Hound, standing 46cm from shoulder to floor. He’s currently based at our Nicosia sanctuary.

Oscar joined our sanctuary with his friend Yennefer earlier in the year. We’re helping a dear friend and rescuer extraordinaire who’s been trying to rehome this sweet boy since rescuing him in 2021, after he survived one of the worst fires Cyprus has ever seen.

His companion Yennefer has since travelled to the UK, and we’re hoping Oscar won’t be far behind. He would truly thrive in a home where he can have a comfy bed to call his own.

Oscar was born with a malformed back leg and was likely deemed “no use” to the hunter who owned him, leaving him sadly discarded.

Thankfully, he was found by our kind friend and blossomed under her care. He made friends with all the other dogs and cats in her home.

Despite missing one of his back feet, Oscar walks and runs without issue—you’d barely notice anything amiss. He walks well on the lead, enjoys canine company, and could happily join a home with dog-savvy children (especially if they have hotdog sausages!).

It’s time for this brave, affectionate boy to find his forever family and enjoy the life of comfort and love he so deserves.

SPDC adoption package and home checks apply.

name: Sherbet
description:
Sherbet is a medium sized crossbreed aged around 7 years old.

Even in the stressful setting of a public shelter, Sherbet was a little ray of sunshine. When we visited in January she was so pleased to see us and welcomed us with her very best full body wag! She is now in a UK foster home and looking for a new start with a new family.

Sherbet is a very submissive girl who spends an awful lot of her time on her back asking for belly rubs. When she knows and trusts you she is the most loyal and affectionate girl but she does take a few days to trust new people, particularly men.

She is mixing well with the dogs in her foster home but would be just as happy as the only dog in the home. She will need an adult family due to her initial nervousness with new people.

name: Oliver
description:
Oliver is a 2 year old medium-sized male Istrian Hound Cross, currently living at the Nicosia sanctuary.

Sweet Oliver is a gorgeous boy with the most fabulous long, soft ears! He was found by a man who wanted to adopt him, but unfortunately, the resident male dog was not a fan, so Oliver needed help finding a new home.

Oliver has adapted well to sanctuary life but would really love a home to call his own. He can be a bit of a goofball and enjoys playing, often picking up a toy to entertain himself and visitors alike.

He’s a big foodie and loves a treat or two. As an Istrian Hound Cross, he is likely calm and docile, but also a strong hunter, so he’s best suited to a home without small animals.

Oliver is very affectionate and loves cuddles. He enjoys meeting visitors at the sanctuary and is sure to be a loving and loyal companion in the right home.

SPDC adoption package and home checks apply.

name: Jessie
description:
Jessie is an approximately 4 year old female small to medium sized cross breed who is currently being fostered in Norwich, Norfolk, East Anglia.

She was rescued from a kill shelter in Romania and taken to a safe private shelter, giving her the opportunity to leave behind an uncertain past and begin looking forward to a better future.

Sadly, Jessie appears to have experienced difficult times, with worry and possible mistreatment having left her a rather timid and reserved girl.

She is naturally quiet and can be a little cautious when meeting new people, preferring to take her time before deciding whether someone can be trusted.

However, once she gets to know you and feels comfortable in your company, a much sweeter side of her personality begins to shine through.

She is described as an extremely sweet and docile girl who simply needs a little patience and understanding while she learns that not everyone is going to hurt her.

She would benefit from a kind and gentle owner who will allow her to settle at her own pace without putting pressure on her to be more confident than she naturally is.

Jessie gets along well with the other dogs in her foster home and is comfortable sharing her space with them. However, she is not particularly interested in playing or joining in with their activities just yet.

She is much happier quietly curling up in a comfortable bed, having a peaceful place to relax with people she can learn to trust. Passed cat testing.

When it comes to her ideal home, Jessie would particularly appreciate a quiet adult household where she can enjoy a relaxed routine without too much noise or activity.

She is not looking for a busy environment and would benefit from having the space and time to build confidence and form a bond with her new family.

Visiting children should be absolutely fine, provided they are respectful, although Jessie is unlikely to take much notice of them and will probably prefer to settle quietly in her own comfortable spot.

Her new owners will need to understand that earning her trust may take a little time, but once she feels safe and secure, they will discover a wonderfully sweet, gentle and affectionate companion.

Jessie has clearly been through more than her fair share of difficult experiences, and now she deserves a home where she can finally feel safe, loved and settled.

She may not be the sort of dog who rushes up to everyone she meets, but for someone willing to give her the time and patience she needs, she has so much affection and companionship to offer.

A quiet home, a comfortable bed and a family she can trust are all Jessie is really asking for.

Most harnesses are not escape proof, but harnesses with a strap behind the rib cage (e.g. Ruffwear Webmaster or Perfect Fit Harnesses) are safer.

name: Vic
description:
Vic is a 7 month old male medium sized cross breed who is currently being fostered in Norwich, Norfolk, East Anglia.

He has had a difficult start to life, having been rescued from a public shelter in Romania alongside his mother, Via, and his sibling, Vasi.

A kind woman initially saved them and took them home, but unfortunately, her husband was unhappy about the situation. As a result, they were taken to a property where the owners had a vineyard.

This is how their mother came to be named Via. Sadly, she was kept chained up to prevent her from wandering away whilst  Vic and Vasi remained by her side.

The woman often tried to visit and bring them food but the little family were often left hungry. Thankfully a few months ago, they were offered a place at Stella’s shelter and have had the opportunity to receive care and prepare for a better future.

Vic has a wonderful personality and is described as a comical, chatty little boy who brings plenty of character to those around him.

He is also very loving and affectionate, making him a lovely young dog for someone looking for a companion with plenty of personality.

He is still only a youngster, so he will need the usual patience, guidance, training and consistency that come with raising a puppy as he continues to grow and develop.

His new family will need to give him time to settle into his new surroundings, establish routines and help him learn what is expected of him.

With his affectionate nature and entertaining personality, Vic has the potential to become a very rewarding addition to the right home.

Vic is generally mixing well with the other dogs in his foster home, although he can sometimes become a little jealous.

For this reason, he may find it easier to settle into a home where he is the only dog, allowing him to enjoy the attention without having to share it with other dogs.

Vic could live with respectful children aged ten and over, provided they understand how to behave appropriately around dogs and give him the space and consideration he needs.

After such an unsettled beginning, Vic deserves the opportunity to experience life as a much-loved family member, with a comfortable home, regular meals, affection and the security of knowing he is finally somewhere permanent.

He is a charming, affectionate and entertaining young boy who is now waiting for someone to give him the chance he deserves.

name: Rocky
description:
Rockyisanapproximately5 year oldmalecross breedwhomaybesmallinsize,buthecertainlyhasabigpersonality.

He has tested positive for heartworm – medication for treatment will be provided for however long needed with no cost to adopter.

Thislittlechaphasplentyofcharacterandislookingforalovinghomewherehecanfeelsafe,settledandtrulypartofthefamily.HeiscurrentlybeingfosteredinSwaffham,Norfolk,andishopingtofindhisforeverhome.

Sadly,Rockyhasnothadtheeasieststartinlife.HewasfoundwanderingthestreetsinRomaniaafterbeingattackedbyapackofdogswhowerefightingoverafemaledog.

Hisrescuersdescribedhimaslookingasthoughhehadbeeninaboxingmatch,givingsomeindicationofthedifficultexperiencehehadendured.

Despitehisunfortunatepast,Rockyisnowlookingforafreshstartwithsomeonewhowillofferhimthelove,patienceandsecurityhedeserves.

Rockywouldideallyprefertobetheonlydoginhisnewhome.Hecanbealittlejealous,sohewouldlikelybehappiesthavinghisfamily’sattentiontohimself.

However,hemaybeabletosharehishomewiththerightfemaledog,providedthematchissuitable.Hiscompatibilitywithanotherdogwouldthereforeneedtobeconsideredcarefullywhenfindinghisidealhome.

Whenitcomestochildren,Rockycouldlivewithrespectfulchildrenaged10andover.Hewouldbebestsuitedtoahomewhereolderchildrenunderstandhowtointeractappropriatelywithdogsandcanrespecthisspaceandneeds.

Rockyhasnotyetbeencat-tested,sohissuitabilityforlivingwithcatsiscurrentlyunknown.

Rockyisnowlookingforaspecialpersonorfamilywhocanofferhimasecureandlovingenvironmentwherehecanenjoylifeandreceiveplentyofaffection.Hedeservesthechancetoenjoyahappyfuture.

name: Lolek
description:
Lolek is a 3.5-month-old male Cross-Breed available for adoption. He was born approximately 3.5 months ago and can travel to his new home once he reaches 4 months, depending on the development of his teeth.

Currently located in Tecuci, Romania, Lolek is part of a small breed and is eagerly waiting for a loving family to adopt him. His breed is an unknown mix, adding to his unique charm.

Lolek has been thoroughly prepared for adoption; he is vaccinated, blood tested, treated for fleas and worms, and microchipped. With rescue back up and support available in the UK, potential adopters can feel secure in their decision to bring Lolek into their home.

A home check and adoption process will apply to ensure a suitable environment for him.

Lolek and his brother, Bolek, were found abandoned on a freezing winter day, which highlights the resilience of these little pups.

A kind lady rescued them from the streets and sought help for their care, leading to their current situation where they are receiving the love and attention they deserve. Lolek is a playful sweetheart who thrives on human interaction and loves to be pampered.

He is sociable with the other dogs in the yard, indicating his friendly disposition, and is comfortable around cats as well. This sociability makes him an ideal candidate for a home with other pets.

It is estimated that Lolek will remain small when he fully grows up, making him a perfect fit for families looking for a compact companion.

name: Gia
description:
Introducing Gia! Once upon a time, on a mountain in Croatia, a beautiful dog with a poorly leg wandered aimlessly after she was hit by a car.

Despite her physical pain, no one seemed to notice her. Gia, with her gentle eyes and a spirit that refused to be broken, longed for help, and the Zarkovica team were notified and came to her aid.

Despite her hardships, Gia harboured no ill will towards humans. Although shy, she shows no aggression towards people.

Her leg couldn’t be saved due to the trauma she suffered during those painful times, but she has since undergone surgery to remove it and has fully recovered physically.

Gia will be happiest with another dog or dogs, as she prefers their company and gains confidence when in their presence, having lived in a huge pack for most of her life. She walks wonderfully with the team and enjoys her daily outings.

Gia is fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed. She will travel on approved transport with her very own passport directly to her new home.

The application and checks apply through RBU – Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

name: Golda
description:
Golda is a 10-year-old female Cross-Breed with a heart as pure as gold. She has spent much of her life navigating the streets, demonstrating remarkable resilience and strength. Despite her difficult past, she remains a gentle and shy soul, always radiating a quiet charm that makes her truly special.

Golda prefers a peaceful environment over a busy, bustling one. She is the kind of dog who would rather curl up by your side than run around in a crowded park. Her calm and patient nature makes her a wonderful companion for those who appreciate a serene and soothing presence at home.

Although she has seen many challenges in life, Golda remains full of love to give. She has a sweet and endearing personality that will bring warmth to any home. She is well-behaved and content with a simple life, making her a perfect match for someone looking for a low-energy, loving companion.

Golda gets along well with other dogs and can live harmoniously with cats. However, she would be best suited to an adult-only home, where she can enjoy a quiet and relaxed environment.

Having already been vaccinated, blood-tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed, Golda is ready to find her forever home.

If you’re looking for a loyal and affectionate companion to share peaceful moments with, Golda is the perfect choice. She is waiting for a special person to give her the love and security she truly deserves.

Adopt Golda and let her spend her golden years surrounded by warmth, care, and unconditional love.

name: Viva
description:
Viva is an 8-year-old female cross breed dog currently looking for a foster home. She is a loving and loyal companion who radiates warmth and positivity.

Despite being a senior, she still has plenty of love to give and embodies the gentle, calm nature that makes older dogs such wonderful companions.

Viva is friendly with both dogs and cats, making her a great addition to a multi-pet household. She is fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed.

Her travel costs from Croatia to the UK are covered by the voluntary organisation, and she is available through Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

If you are looking for a devoted friend and a sweet, affectionate dog to brighten your home, fostering Viva could be a truly rewarding experience.

name: Blossom
description:
Blossom is a 5-year-old female Cross-Breed who will turn 6 in December. She is a medium-sized dog currently located in Romania, waiting for her forever home through Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed, Blossom is well-prepared for her next chapter in a loving home.

With a heart full of love and an eagerness to please, Blossom’s friendly demeanour makes her a joy to be around. She has a naturally gentle and calm personality, making her an excellent companion for peaceful and cosy moments at home.

Whether it’s a movie night on the sofa or a quiet evening with a book, she’ll happily be by your side, soaking up all the affection she can get.

Loyalty is one of Blossom’s greatest strengths. She is the kind of dog who will stand by her family through thick and thin, offering unwavering companionship.

Her affectionate nature means she thrives on human interaction and loves to cuddle. Anyone looking for a devoted and loving pet will find the perfect match in Blossom.

Blossom is dog-friendly and has already been lead-trained, making her an easy companion for walks and outdoor adventures. She can also be cat-tested upon request for potential adopters with feline family members.

Given her gentle and social nature, she would make a wonderful addition to the right home, bringing warmth, joy, and unconditional love.

name: Rio
description:
Meet Rio: Rio is a 3 1/2 year old male Siberian Husky currently located in Croatia and available for adoption.

Sadly, he never had a real home. Life in a derelict box, without going out, we can’t call home, nor is it the life that any creature deserves. We cannot change the past, but we can guarantee a wonderful future.

Rio is a cheerful dog, full of life and desire for adventure. He is not trained to live in a home, and we are looking for a home with a fenced garden so that he can slowly get used to entering inside. He rejoices at all people and jumps a meter high when people approach his box. He adores cats and has shared boxing with them.

Rio is vaccinated, chipped, and neutered. In other words, he is ready to start his new life with someone who will love and care for him.

If you are looking for a friend forever, Rio is here, ready to give you all his love!

name: Ljubica
description:
Ljubica is a 13 year old female Cross-Breed is a medium-sized dog weighing 21 kilograms and standing 46 cm tall. Currently located in Croatia, Ljubica has spent her entire life in a shelter and is now ready to find her forever home.

Ljubica wants a patient home where the residents won’t expect her to shower them with affection and kisses straight away. It’s clear that she has had little human affection during her incredibly difficult life.

In a retirement home, she wants the freedom to live her life at her own pace.

Ljubica has never behaved aggressively towards those who care for her. She is simply a fearful soul, and it breaks our hearts that such a lovely dog is frightened of anything in this world.

She would thrive in a household with another calm and friendly dog. Ljubica is still learning to walk on the lead and will need time and understanding to settle.

She is vaccinated, microchipped, spayed, and has her passport ready. Ljubica is looking for someone who will love and care for her in her golden years.

If you are looking for a loyal and loving friend, Ljubica is here, ready to start her new life with you.

name: Milo
description:
Milo is a 3 year old male Cross-Breed, small to medium in size, standing 33cm tall and weighing 11kg.

He was abandoned in a park in Tecuci, Romania, and was going to eat at a rescuer’s door.

After being taken in by a kind lady and her daughter, Milo struggled to fit in with their two dogs, leading them to seek help.

Today, Milo is completely integrated with the other 30 dogs in the rescue yard. He is a gorgeous, cuddly dog who loves human contact and enjoys being petted and stroked.

He is sociable with other dogs and does not show any aggression towards the rescue’s cats. Milo is castrated, vaccinated, microchipped, and dewormed, with an EU passport and a full adoption contract.

He can live, after gradual introduction, with other dogs, cats, and children. Adopting a dog is a very big decision, so please make sure you are ready for the challenge and commitment.

Are you prepared to take care of them, pay their vet bills, feed them, walk them, and consider them a family member for the rest of their life?

name: Spirit
description:
Hello there! My name’s Spirit, a 3 year old male Cross-Breed from Romania, full of life and energy.

I was rescued from a field where I was attached to a chain 24 hours a day. My fur was matted, my skin was sore, and I was crawling with fleas—it was so uncomfortable for me.

Succeeding Paragraphs (Copied and Punctuated):

Despite those awful days, weeks and years of my life, I remain forgiving and happy.

I’m super friendly with people, other dogs, and children over 10.

I love to play, run around and roll in the long grass now that I am free from those horrible chains.I currently reside in private foster in Romania under the care of NGO Andreea.

I am super excited for what the future holds for me and what adventures can be made now that I have a new lease of life.

name: Viva
description:
Viva is an 8-year-old female Cross-Breed. She is a senior lady with a heart full of love, looking for a warm and caring home to spend her golden years.

Despite a past that may not have been the kindest, she remains full of spirit and affection, ready to give and receive love.

Throughout her life, Viva has been nurturing and caring, and now it’s her turn to receive the love and attention she deserves.

She gets along wonderfully with other dogs and even cats, making her a perfect fit for a multi-pet household. Her gentle and friendly nature means she will easily become a cherished companion.

At 50 cm tall and weighing 22 kg, Viva is a medium-sized dog with a sturdy build. She may be a senior, but she still has plenty of companionship and devotion to offer.

Her loving nature and calm temperament make her an ideal dog for someone looking for a loyal and affectionate friend.

Viva is fully vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and spayed. She is currently in Croatia but can travel to the UK through Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue once she finds a home.

Adopting Viva means giving a second chance to a dog who truly deserves it—one who will fill your home with love and loyalty.

name: Vigo
description:
Vigo is a 12.5-year-old male Chow-Croatian cross looking for a loving home to spend his golden years.

Despite his age, he still has a zest for life and enjoys walks, water, and curling up on the sofa after a day of adventure.

He is a well-mannered and affectionate boy, great with people, dogs, and cats, making him a fantastic addition to any family home.

Vigo is well-trained, walks perfectly on a lead, and is eager to please, ensuring he will settle into a new home with ease.

Fully vaccinated, blood tested, neutered, flea and worm treated, and microchipped, Vigo is ready to travel to the UK in March via Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

If you’re looking for a loyal, loving companion, Vigo could be the perfect match.

name: Ricky
description:
Ricky, a 1.5-year-old male with a small stature cross-breed, seeks a loving family from Romania.

His journey began with abandonment, leaving his parentage a mystery, but his resilient spirit shines bright as he searches for a home to call his own.

Despite the challenges he’s faced, Ricky’s gentle nature and affinity for companionship make him an ideal furry friend for the right family.

In his interactions with other dogs, Ricky exudes kindness and tranquility, fostering harmonious relationships with his fellow canines.

Human contact brings Ricky joy, and he readily welcomes new faces without a trace of shyness. His leash manners are commendable, as he walks with ease and enthusiasm through the shelter fields, relishing the opportunity to explore his surroundings.

While in the shelter, Ricky has had positive interactions with children, showcasing his adaptable and amiable nature in various social settings.

Though Ricky has made strides in his journey, he still requires guidance and training in certain aspects of dog ownership, such as car rides and recall.

Therefore, an ideal home for Ricky would be one that offers patience, understanding, and support as he continues to adjust to his new life.

A secure garden would provide Ricky with space for play and ongoing training, while older children would complement his temperament and energy level.

Ricky comes with a clean bill of health, having been vaccinated, blood tested, flea and worm treated, microchipped, and neutered.

With his past behind him and a bright future ahead, Ricky eagerly awaits the opportunity to bring joy and companionship to a compassionate family.

name: Eric
description:
Eric is an 8–9-year-old male Cross-Breed. This distinguished gentleman is currently living in Romania under UK rescue backup, patiently waiting for the perfect retirement home.

After years of uncertainty, he deserves a peaceful and loving home where he can finally rest his paws.

A shelter is no place for a senior dog like Eric. In his later years, what he truly needs is a warm bed, a soft blanket, and a quiet corner next to the fire.

It would be his greatest wish to find a home before the cold winter sets in. Eric dreams of spending his golden years surrounded by comfort, care, and companionship.

Health-wise, Eric is in good shape with no known medical concerns, allergies, or food intolerances. He’s a calm and gentle soul who would thrive in a relaxed environment where his humans can devote time and love to him.

A retired person or couple looking for a low-energy, affectionate companion would be ideal.

Eric would love a garden to wander around at his own pace, enjoying fresh air and short bursts of activity. He’s not suited to living with cats or small children but could share his home with a calm female dog.

Short walks, time in the garden, and plenty of naps would suit him perfectly.

His rescuers emphasise that adopting a dog like Eric requires patience, understanding, and long-term commitment. Rescue dogs may carry emotional baggage, and some can display challenging behaviours.

However, with kindness and consistency, Eric is sure to reward his adopters with unconditional love and loyalty.

name: Billy
description:
Billy is a smallish crossbreed aged around three years old. Billy fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Billy was found outside the gates of the Crivatu private shelter in Romania around a year or so ago and pretty much invited himself inside. He has lived happily there until recently joining us in the UK to look for his forever home.

Billy is a cute little “man about town” kind of guy with a lot of character. Secretly he’s quite sensitive and insecure with new people and new situations but he “styles it out” with an air of nonchalance initially.

A couple of days later when he realises he’s in safe hands he is your best and most loyal friend. Billy loves a fuss and a cuddle, he’s enjoying his walks and loving being a domestic house dog.

He is more wary of men than women and can be nervous of visitors to the house.

Billy would like an adult home environment.

He was previously adopted with a shy dog but once established, he would try to bully her and she was not brave enough to stand up to him, so he would need to be the only dog in the home or could live with a dog that would not stand for that behaviour.

He’s currently living happily with many other dogs coming and going with no issues.

name: Bandit
description:
Our extra special boy Bandit is approximately two years old and a delightful and incredibly attractive cross breed towards the bottom end of medium.

Bandit weighs just fourteen kilos and measures fifteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets Bandit has been our Cyprus shelter for two weeks.

Our shelter manager describes Bandit as having perfect manners and enjoys making eye contact; he would make the most marvellous family companion.

Being a low maintenance boy, Bandit is included to blend with the crowd and socialises beautifully.

His personality shines bright with kindness, gentility and calmness. Bandit is stunningly attractive with array of tan in his glorious coat and his eyes shine.

Such a good looking and handsome boy. A readymade adoption candidate for an extremely lucky family.

Bandit walks nicely on his lead and enjoys his time in the car. He seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy is a 6-year-old female Cross-Breed. She’s a big-hearted, lovable soul who has already been through quite a journey. Rescued from Breasta Public Shelter in April 2023, Lucy was one of the lucky ones pulled to safety just in time.

Now she’s living in a secure shelter in Romania, waiting for her forever home through Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue UK.

Lucy is friendly with people, dogs, and even cats. Despite not currently living with them, she shows good social skills and an easygoing nature that makes her a joy to be around.

She enjoys human contact, happily accepting strokes and affection from those she trusts.

At the shelter, Lucy has made friends with the smaller dogs and gets along well with them. Although she’s larger in size, she’s gentle and well-balanced, showing patience and calmness around others.

Lucy is still learning lead training and needs a bit of extra support with her house training, but her sweet temperament and willingness to learn make her a wonderful candidate for a loving family.

This beautiful girl has a calm, relaxed nature that’s hard not to fall for. Once settled into her forever home, Lucy is sure to repay all the love and kindness shown to her with loyalty, affection, and lifelong friendship.

Whoever adopts Lucy will truly be gaining a best friend for life.

name: Maudy
description:
Maudy is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed.

This happy little girl is ready to find a family of her own, and we think she is going to bring so much joy to the lucky people who welcome her home.

Maudy is a cheerful, friendly girl who loves people and gets on well with other dogs. She has a lovely nature and is a real delight to be around.

Now all she needs is someone to give her the chance to discover just how wonderful life in a loving home can be.

Maudy was found with a broken leg, but thankfully this has been successfully repaired and she has no ongoing issues from her injury.

She has been through a lot, but she hasn’t lost her happy spirit, and now it is time for her next chapter.

Maudy hasn’t yet experienced life in a home, so her new family will need to be patient and help her learn all the little things that many dogs take for granted.

She will need support with basic house training and getting used to household routines.

She has started walking on a lead, but she will need continued training and encouragement to build her confidence and skills. A secure garden will be essential.

Maudy needs time to settle into her new home, get to know her family and become comfortable in her surroundings before gradually venturing out on walks. She is cat-friendly.

There is no need to rush her; the important thing is to help her feel safe and secure as she learns about her new world.

Maudy could potentially live with sensible children, preferably older ones who understand how to behave kindly and respectfully around a dog.

She could also live with another friendly, compatible dog.

A happy, friendly girl who enjoys people and other dogs.

Spayed, vaccinated and has her pet passport. Her previously broken leg has been repaired, with no ongoing issues.

A secure garden and a family willing to help her settle.

Patience with house training, lead skills and all the new experiences of home life.

Maudy is a delightful little girl with so much love and happiness to share. She doesn’t need a perfect home or a family who knows everything already; she needs people who will give her time, kindness and the opportunity to learn at her own pace.

Could you be the family who helps Maudy begin her wonderful new life?

name: Bradley
description:
Meet the extremely handsome 4 year old male Cross-Breed Bradley.

This wonderful boy is ready for lots of fun with his new family.

Bradley is definitely the best furry friend you’ve been looking for.

A bouncy, cheeky, happy lad 4 Years old large size bundle of love.

He is more than ready to finally travel to his forever home.

Bradley loves water balls and running around the shelter playground. A fabulous boy who will keep you on your toes with endless hours of fun.

Bradley loves people very much and will let you throw his ball for hours. A active home is definitely needed for Bradley who have time and energy.

He walks wonderful on lead and is looking forward to lots of adventures in his new home ? No small children in his home due to his very bouncy nature.

Bradley is fully vaccinated, microchipped, flea and worm treated, neutered, brucellosis and leishmania tested, and vet checked.

Bradley currently resides in Bosnia under the care of Azil Danica 48hr quarantine in the U.K. for Bosnian dogs.

Rbu in the U.K. – Meadow Of Hope Dog Rescue UK Application and checks apply.

Let’s help make Bradley’s dreams come true.

name: Cosmo
description:
Cosmo is a 3-year-old male Cross-Breed. He comes across as upbeat and full of charm, carrying himself with a touch more confidence than his sister Nova.

He already shows the kind of gentle personality that makes people warm up to him fast.

Cosmo is currently staying in a private shelter in Romania, waiting for his chance to make the trip to the UK.

He shares a tight bond with Nova, and the two of them move through life like a little ready-made family.

Anyone thinking about adopting a pair would find these siblings a seriously wholesome match.

Cosmo has a small scar on his nose, but it doesn’t dim his sweetness in the slightest. He’s vaccinated, blood tested, and spayed, making him all set for a smooth transition into a forever home.

Pennypaws Rescue will be there with full rescue backup and support, along with a required video home check to make sure everything’s a good fit.

name: Tally
description:
Beautiful Tally is a 5 year old female American Bulldog, who experienced untold traumas before arriving in the care of the One Wish Dog Foundation. Tally is currently in foster in Oxfordshire.

Before being found by the dog warden, Tally had been moved from pillar to post, being relentlessly bred from before being left to starve in a filthy drug den.

Riddled with mange and dangerously skinny, Tally’s eyes were almost completely closed up from swelling and she had lost most of her fur from infections. Her back legs were also stiff and sore from emaciation, and being kept in a cage with no freedom and exercise.

If you’re following Tally’s journey on our social media pages, you’ll know that this special girl is now recovering from her traumas in a lovely, cosy home and she has made an incredible transformation thanks to expert medical advice and treatment.

You’ll notice from her photos how much better she is looking and feeling now.

Tally is now vaccinated and once she is fully back to health, she will also be spayed. No more pups for this poor darling, we dread to think how many litters she was forced to have.

What is most amazing about Tally is how, despite everything she has been put through by humans, she refuses to lose faith in us.

She looks to us for safety and comfort, and she is so, so gentle and trusting. She’s quite simply incredible and we’re totally committed to finding her happy ever after.?

We’ll accept nothing short of a 5* home for this exceptional soul. She is able to live with other dogs and children. She has been in contact with cats in foster care but we would prefer for her to go to a cat-free home for safety reasons due to her size.

If you think you might be able to offer our amazing Tally a lifetime of love and all the attention in the world, please do get in touch.
